articles.title_kr: 무등산 안심사 개판본의 서지적 연구
articles.title_en: A Bibliographic study On Reprinted Edition Of Mudeungsan Ansimsa Temple
articles.abstract_kr: 무등산 안심사는 8세기경 초창하여 19세기 중후반경 폐사된 사찰로 서지사 측면에서 큰 의미를 갖는 사찰이다. 1569년 10종의 불서가 개판되고, 1570년 9종의 불서가 개판 되었으며, 1573년 1종의 불서가 개판 되었다. 또한 1772년에는 문집과 진양하씨 세보인 족보가 간행되어 22종의 전적을 간행한 사찰이었다.한때는 불화를 제작하는 화사가 유파를 형성하면서 번성했던 사찰로 1770년 안심사에서 조성하여 순천 송광사로 이운하여 대화엄전에 봉안한 화엄경변상도의 조성처이기도 하였다. 특히 안심사는 18세기경 송광사의 부휴계와 밀접한 관계를 맺은 사찰로 부휴계 법손들이 활동하던 도량이었다.안심사에서 간행된 판본의 판식 특징은 모든 개판본의 변란은 사주단변이며, 판심의 어미는 상하내향흑어미로 이뤄져 있다. 계선은 일부 유계가 있기는 하나 대체로 무계로 이뤄져 있다.개판에 간여한 인물을 정리하면, 대부분의 불서 개판을 지도하고 교정을 맡은 인물은 설은이며, 그는 화엄종 계통의 대선 법계를 가진 인물이다.불서 간행을 전반적으로 주도하는 소임을 화주나 화사 또는 권화라고 하는데 경련, 인주, 혜증이 주로 역할을 하였다.불서 간행에 가장 핵심적인 역할은 각수의 소임인데 안심사에서 간행된 『옥추경』이나 『최상승론』의 간행기에 법운, 일흔 등 20인의 각수가 참여하였음을 기록하고 있다. 특히 『옥추경』, 『제진언집』 변상도의 변상내부에 ‘法云刀’가 별도로 새겨진 것을 볼 때 법운은 변상 전문 각수임을 알 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: Ansimsa Temple was built around the 8th century and disappeared around the mid-to-late 19th century. It is a very important temple in the history of bibliography. There were reprinted ten Buddhist writings in 1569, nine in 1570, and one in 1573. Also In 1772, there were published 22 kinds of books, including collection works and genealogies of the Jinyang-Ha’s clan. There was such a popular temple that the artist who produced Buddhist paintings formed a school at that time. In 1770, it was created by Ansimsa Temple, moved to Songgwangsa Temple in Suncheon, and created the Hwaeomgyeongbyeonsangdo, which was enshrined in Daehwaeomjeon. In particular, Ansimsa Temple around the 18th century was a temple closely related to Songgwangsa Temple’s buhyugye. And the descendants of the buhygye continued to work there. Several intermediate versions published by Ansimsa Temple consisted of a single-lined rectangular box (四周單邊), no column lines (無界), and its center of folded leaves contained a shape of fish tales directed inward within a large black square (上下內向魚尾). Seol-eun was a person who followed the Dharma heir of the Hwaeomjong clan and played a role in reprinting and correcting most Buddhist books. People who lead the pulication of Buddhist books are called Hwaju, Hwasa, or Gweonhwa. Kyung Ryeon, In Ju, and Hye Jeung were the ones who played the roles. Gaksu (刻手) is the person who plays the most important role in publishing Buddhist books. There is a record that 20 Gaksu, including Buop-un and Il-hun, participated in the publication of Okchugyeong (玉樞經) or Choisangseunggyeong (最上乘經) that was made by Ansimsa Temple. In particular, he looks like a special Gaksu that Buop-un, his name(法云刀) given, is engraved on the picture in the Okcukyung and Jejinunjip(諸眞言集).

articles.title_kr: 현대 한국승가의 생산불교 정향(正向)
articles.title_en: The Right Direction of Production Buddhism in Modern Korean Saṃgha
articles.abstract_kr: 현재, 한국불교는 생산불교를 당연시 여기는 경향이 있다. 생산불교는 ‘승가가 신도의 보시 이외에 육체적 노동이나 상업적 행위를 함으로써 재정을 확충하는 것’이라고 정의할 수 있다. 이러한 경향은 신도의 보시만으로는 불교교단을 운영하기 어려운 상황으로부터 비롯된다. 그러나 불교교단의 재정 부족이 생산불교의 수용에 대한 타당성을 온전히 제공해주지는 못한다.이에 본고는 생산불교의 문제점을 분석하여, 그 정향적(正向的) 과제를 제시하였다. 우선, 문제점으로는 다음의 네 가지를 도출하였다. 첫째, 생산불교는 승가의 노동과 붓다의 교설 간 괴리를 유발할 수 있다. 둘째, 생산불교는 승가의 세속화를 심화시킬 수 있다. 셋째, 생산불교는 승가의 부익부 빈익빈을 초래할 수 있다. 넷째, 생산불교는 승가 단독의 교단 운영 구조를 형성할 수 있다.이를 바탕으로 본고는 불교교단의 생산활동이 불교적 정체성을 지키며 이루어질 수 있도록 정향적 과제를 실천방안과 더불어 제시하였다. 첫째, 승려의 노동과 수행 간의 교리적 간극이 해소될 수 있도록, 승려의 생산활동(노동)이 깨달음에 도달하는 하나의 방편(수행)이라는 논리 구조를 논증하였다. 둘째, 비영리단체에 부합하는 생산불교가 이루어질 수 있도록, 중생의 고통 해소와 최소 이윤을 추구하는 사업 방안들을 검토하였다. 셋째, 평등공동체인 승가의 재정이 투명해지고 수익이 공유될 수 있도록, 승가가 붓다가 정한 소유와 분배의 원칙을 지킬 수 있는 방안을 모색하였다. 넷째, 재가신도가 생산불교의 주체자라는 의식을 강화할 수 있도록, 재가신도들이 자신의 복만을 구하는데 그치지 말고 사찰과 종단의 생산활동에 능동적으로 참여해야 함을 강조하였다.
articles.abstract_en: Currently, Korean Buddhism tends to take production Buddhism for granted. Production Buddhism can be defined as ‘an increase in finances by the saṃgha performing physical labor or commercial activities other than believer’s donation.’ This trend of Korean Buddhism stems from the situation where it is difficult to operate a Buddhist denomination only by believer’s donation. However, the lack of finances of the Buddhist denomination does not provide full validity for the acceptance of production Buddhism.Therefore, this paper analyzed the problems of production Buddhism and tried to suggest the correct direction of it. In this regard, the following four problems were presented. First, production Buddhism can lead to a discrepancy between the Buddhist monk’s labor and the Buddha’s doctrine. Second, production Buddhism can deepen the secularization of the saṃgha. Third, production Buddhism can lead to the gap between the rich and the poor. Fourth, production Buddhism can form a denominational operating structure of the saṃgha alone.Therefore, this paper presents the correct direction along with practical plans so that the production activities of the Buddhist denomination can be carried out while maintaining the Buddhist identity. First, The logical structure of the monk’s production activity (labor) as a way to reach enlightenment (zen practice) was demonstrated. Second, business plans aimed at relieving people’s suffering and pursuing minimal profits were reviewed. Third, the saṃgha sought a way to uphold the principles of ownership and distribution set forth by the Buddha. Fourth, It suggested the need for lay believers to actively participate in the productive activities of Buddhist temples and Orders.

articles.title_kr: 태교에서 명상의 활용방안 연구 - 불교 소리명상 프로그램을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: Study on the Use of Meditation in Prenatal Education - Focusing on Buddhist Sound Meditation Programs -
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 불교 소리명상 프로그램 개발을 위한 기초연구로써 프로그램의 이론적 토대를 고찰하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 관련 문헌을 고찰하고 불교 소리명상 프로그램을 정의하며 태교로써 불교 소리명상 프로그램 개발을 위한 제언을 한다.연구결과 불교적 관점에서 태교는 태내기부터 현생의 업이 시작되기 때문에 그 필요성이 있으며 어머니가 쌓은 선업을 태아에게 회향하여 업의 변화를 가져 온다는 측면에서 자리이타의 실천이라고 볼 수 있다.한편 소리는 훌륭한 명상의 매개이다. 특히 『능엄경』에 등장하는 이근의 성품 중 통진실(通眞實)은 자궁 밖 소리도 들을 수 있는 태아의 이근에도 적용되어 소리를 활용한 태교가 활발하게 이루어지고 있으나 이를 명상으로 발전시킨 소리명상 프로그램은 찾아보기 힘들다.소리명상은 첫째, 뇌파동조화 현상을 활용한 명상, 둘째, 악기 소리를 듣거나 연주하는 명상. 셋째, 만트라, 다라니, 염불 등을 입으로 소리 내는 명상. 넷째, 명상음악을 감상하거나 마음챙김 하며 듣는 명상. 다섯째, 소리의 본질을 알아차리는 이근원통 수행 이렇게 다섯 가지로 분류 할 수 있다. 그 중 불교와 관련된 소리명상은 불교 소리명상 프로그램의 주요 활동 내용이 된다.이러한 고찰을 토대로 불교 소리명상 프로그램은 불교의 교리를 기반으로 하는 소리명상 프로그램으로 기존에 행해지고 있는 불교 소리명상 활동들을 활용하면서 궁극적으로 아공(我空)의 체득을 최종 목표로 하는 대중을 위한 명상 프로그램으로 정의할 수 있다. 대중은 자신이 고통에서 벗어나거나 행복해지기 위해 명상을 한다는 측면에서 나에 대한 집착을 끊어 내어 아공을 체득하는 것을 최종 목표로 삼았다. 이는 이근원통의 육결 중 해근결에 이르는 것을 의미하며 불교의 핵심 교리를 전달하고자 이근원통 수행을 매 회기 다루도록 구성하고자 한다.향후 본 연구의 연구결과를 반영한 양질의 프로그램 개발을 위해서는 목적성과 체계성, 대중성과 적합성을 염두 해야 하며 임신부의 특성과 필요를 고려하여 프로그램을 개발한다면 임신부와 태아 모두에게 불교적 교리를 전달 할 수 있는 명상 프로그램이 될 것으로 기대된다.
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine the theoretical foundation of the Buddhist sound meditation program. In Buddhism, the moment of fertilization, or the moment when the five aggregates are generated in the womb, are regarded as the moment of birth. Therefore, considering that this life begins from the fetal stage, the concept of prenatal education was formed, and from a Buddhist perspective, prenatal education can be seen as the practice of Ja Li I Ta(自利利他) in the sense that it brings about a change in karma by returning the good karma accumulated by the mother to the fetus.Current sound meditation is, first, sound meditation that utilizes brain wave synchronization, and second, sound meditation that listens to or plays musical instruments. Third, sound meditation, in which mantras, dharani, chanting, etc. are sounded with the mouth. Fourth, sound meditation that involves listening to meditation music or being mindful. Fifth, Lee Geun Won Tong meditation, which recognizes the essence of sound, can be classified into five categories.Based on this theory, the Buddhist sound meditation program can be defined as a sound meditation program aimed at Buddhist doctrine, utilizing existing Buddhist sound meditation activities, and ultimately learn of ‘non-self(anattā)’. As a program for the public, the program is developed with popularity in mind, and Lee Geun-won-tong meditation is covered in each session to convey the core doctrines of Buddhism.In order to develop a Buddhist sound meditation program as prenatal education, it is necessary to construct a systematic program that meets the purpose of prenatal education from the Buddhist perspective of Ja Li I Ta(自利利他), and to develop a program that takes into account popularity and suitability.

articles.title_kr: 인도 티벳에서 중관학파의 차별성에 대한 연구 - 자립논증파와 귀류논증파 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: A Study of the Distiction between Madhyamaka in Indo-Tibetan Buddhism - Focusing on the Svātantrika and Prāsaṅgika Schools -
articles.abstract_kr: 티벳에서 11세기에 파찹 니마닥(Pa tshab Nyi ma grags, 1055?-1145?) 등에 의해 찬드라키르티(Candrakīrti)의 『명구론』(Prasannapadā)이 번역되면서 추론식을 사용한 바비베카(Bhāviveka)에 대한 비판이 알려지게 되었고 귀류파(Prāsaṅgika, Thal ‘gyur ba)라는 용어도 처음 사용되었다. 인도 문헌에는 귀류파라는 용어가 없음에도 불구하고, 인도-티벳 중관 전통은 특히 찬드라키르티의 영향을 통해 자립파와 귀류파 사이의 실질적인 차이를 나타낸다.자립파와 귀류파를 특징짓는 것은 추론식의 수용과 부정의 관점으로 알려진다. 이 논문은 추론식을 구성하는 주장인 증명하고자 하는 법의 속성을 지닌 유법의 공통된 의미에 의한 성립의 차이점을 검토한다. 차이의 본질에는 바른 인식에 의한 성립으로서 후대 귀류파의 논리체계에 중요한 軸이 된다.바비베카는 주장 명제의 법을 지닌 유법의 일반성으로 성립하는 것에 대해 특정한 속성으로서 인식하면 추론 체계와 추론된 것을 방해하기 때문에 공통된 속성으로 논증해야 한다고 말한다. 그는 법과 유법의 단순한 일반성이 이해되는 것처럼 특정하지 않은 속성으로 파악하는 것에 오류가 없다고 『반야등론』(Prajñāpradīpa)에서 말한다.찬드라키르티는 『명구론』에서 유법이 공통된 의미로 성립하는 것에 대해 청변 자신이 세운 논리식 자체로서도 성립하지 않음을 주장하는데, 전도식과 비전도식의 모순으로 설명한다. 월칭의 관점은 티벳에서의 귀류파라는 새로운 관점에 의해 특히 쫑카파가 인도 불교에서 자립파로 분류된 스승들에 의해 다루어졌던 중관의 논의점들에 대해 자신의 해석학적 프레임을 독자적으로 구축하는 근원이 되었다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the philosophical differences between the Svātantrika and Prāsaṅgika schools of Madhyamaka, specifically examining their contrasting approaches to employing logical reasoning (rtags) to establish the generality (sāmānya) of the qualifier-property (dharma) to be proven and the qualificand (dharmin) in the autonomous inference (svatantra anumāna). Candrakīrti’s critique of autonomous inference, which establishes general characteristics, contrasts with Bhāviveka’s support of it, as the discussion shows their differences in relation to valid means of cognition (tshad ma, pramāṇa), highlighting not just a stylistic difference.The distinction between Svātantrika and Prāsaṅgika within the Madhyamaka school of philosophy, which originated during the “later propagation of the doctrine” (phyi dar) in Tibet, is a significant development attributed to the followers of Jayānanda’s disciple Pa tshab nyi ma grags (b. 1055) or his contemporaries. This distinction does not appear in Indian primary sources and represents a retroactive framework applied to Indo-Tibetan Madhyamaka tradition, with Candrakīrti central to the later tradition.Bhāviveka, in his Prajñāpradīpa, argues that inference should focus on the unqualified generality of the relationship between a subject and its property to maintain logical consistency.Candrakīrti, in the PPMV, differentiates between ultimate and conventional existents: the former is the object of unmistaken cognition, and the latter of mistaken cognition. He critiques Bhāviveka by stating that the logical reasoning subject (dharmin) of an unqualified general character (sāmānya) is not established, as it exists only through mistaken cognition. For Candrakīrti, valid means of cognition (tshad ma) perceive ultimate existents through nonconceptual direct perception (pratyakṣa), while conventional existents are perceived erroneously, emphasizing epistemological over ontological status.In the context mentioned, Tsong kha pa, who identified himself as a follower of Candrakīrti and a Prāsaṅgika, incorporated Dharmakīrti’s logico-epistemological insights into his Madhyamaka philosophy, extensively drawing in Candrakīrti’s interpretations of Nāgārjuna’s work.

articles.title_kr: 뉴스 빅데이터를 활용한 사찰림(寺刹林) 관련 사회적 이슈 변화 분석
articles.title_en: Analysis of Changes in Social Issues Related to Temple Forests Using News Big Data
articles.abstract_kr: 우리나라의 사찰림은 경관이 뛰어나고 보존 상태가 양호하여 높은 공익적 가치를 가지고 있는 불교의 유산으로, 불자의 수행 장소이자 사찰 경제의 중심으로 소중하게 관리되며 사회적 요구에 따라 다양한 역할을 하고 있다. 본 연구는 이와 같은 사찰림의 가치와 역할에 대하여 사회적 이슈는 어떻게 변화해 왔는가를 살펴보기 위해 뉴스 빅데이터를 대상으로 텍스트 마이닝 기법을 활용한 분석 및 고찰을 수행하였다.이의 결과로 첫째, 이슈화된 내용을 정리하면 크게 ① 과세 면제와 템플스테이 예산, 문화재 관람료 등, 사찰림에 대한 사회적 인식 부족으로 인한 논쟁과 갈등, ② 대형산불에 기인한 사찰림 보호 활동의 강화, ③ 신재생 에너지, 탄소중립, 북한과의 교류와 같은 사회 공헌 활동 연계 등으로 구분할 수 있다. 이를 통해 사찰림의 기능과 가치에 대한 사회적 인식과 평가는 아직 높지 않다는 것과 불교계는 사찰림을 활용하여 국가와 사회에 대한 기여 활동을 꾸준히 계획하고 실행하고 있다는 것을 알 수 있다. 마지막으로 이슈들의 시간별 변화를 살펴보면 사찰림에 대한 지위와 역할 정립에서 보호 및 활용 방안의 구체화로 이어지며 사회 기여 역할이 확대되고 있음을 볼 수 있다.이 같은 분석 결과에 따라 향후 사찰림의 발전을 위해 우선 고려할 점은 사찰림에 대한 사회적 인식 전환과 가치 제고를 위해 좀 더 적극적인 홍보 및 교육활동에 관한 노력이 필요하고, 향후 사찰림의 지속 가능한 경영과 정부ㆍ사회의 지원 및 공감대를 확대하기 위해서는 탄소중립과 같은 시대적 과제에 대해 좀 더 구체적인 계획과 실행이 필요하다.
articles.abstract_en: Korean temple forests are of high public value as outstanding landscapes and well-preserved Buddhist heritage. They are also carefully managed as places of Buddhist practice and important economic resources for temples, playing a variety of roles according to social needs. Using text mining techniques, this study analyses and examines big data from the news to see how social issues around the value and role of temple forests have changed.As a result, with the exception of general awareness of temple forests, the social issues can be broadly categorised as follows: ① controversies and conflicts due to lack of social awareness of temple forests, ② strengthening protection of temple forests, and ③ social contribution activities. In addition, it can be confirmed that the government and society’s appreciation of the function and value of temple forests is still not high, and the Buddhist community is consistently planning and implementing activities to contribute to the country and society through the use of temple forests. Finally, the changes in issues over time can be summarised as: establishing the status and role of temple forests → specifying protection and use plans → expanding the role of social contribution.According to the results of this analysis, the priority task for the future development of temple forests is to make more active efforts in publicity and education activities to change social awareness of temple forests and increase their value. In addition, more specific planning and implementation of contemporary issues such as carbon neutrality are needed to expand the sustainable management of temple forests and to gain the support and consensus of the government and society.

articles.title_kr: 불교 상담 기반의 챗봇 개발을 위한 기초 연구 - 청정마음봇 구현을 위한 기초 설계 및 개선사항 도출 -
articles.title_en: A Preliminary Study for the Development of a Buddhist Counseling-Based Chatbot - Preliminary Design and Identification of Improvements for the Implementation of Cheongjeongmaeumbot -
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 인공지능 기반 불교 상담 챗봇 즉 청정마음봇의 초기 설계를 통해 내담자 경험을 분석하여, 불교 상담 챗봇의 운용 가능성과 추후 개선사항을 알아보는데 있다. 이를 위하여 연구는 첫째, 청정마음봇이 불교 상담 챗봇으로 기능하기 위한 자료를 구성하고 둘째, 연구 참여자를 모집하여 챗봇을 실제 운영하고 그 경험에 대한 피드백을 받았다.청정마음봇을 개발하기 위한 절차는 상담 시나리오, 번뇌 진단과 솔루션 제공을 위한 자료 구성 순서로 이루어졌다. 불교 상담 프로세스 구성은 기존의 고집멸도 상담 프로세스를 기반으로 두되 챗봇이라는 새로운 환경과 챗봇을 통해 문제를 해결하고자 하는 내담자의 특수성을 고려하여 즉각적이고 신속한 상담을 진행할 수 있도록 진단과 솔루션에 해당하는 고와 도 단계 위주로 구성하였다.번뇌 진단을 위한 자료는 다섯 가지 번뇌를 기반으로 구성하였다. 청정마음봇은 일상적인 수준에서 일어나는 번뇌를 진단하고 줄이는데 초점을 두었다. 이를 위해 다섯 가지 번뇌를 경전과 선행 연구들을 토대로 16가지 번뇌로 세분화하였다. 번뇌 제거 작업은 불교를 응용한 현대 상담심리에서 사용되는 기법들을 기반으로 구성하였다. 번뇌 제거 작업은 총 20가지로 설정되었다.내담자의 경험에 대한 평가 결과 청정마음봇의 활용 가능성과 추후개선사항을 확인하였다. 추후개선사항은 첫째, 번뇌를 진단하기 위한 기준 마련 둘째, 챗봇이라는 새롭고 특수한 환경에서 내담자에게 솔루션 진행 방식에 대한 고찰 셋째, 앞선 두 자료를 통합한 상담 프로세스 구성 및 활용 가능한 불교 상담 챗봇의 구현이다.
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to explore the feasibility and potential improvements of an AI-based Buddhist counseling chatbot, called Cheongjeongmaeumbot, through an analysis of client experiences during its initial design phase. To achieve this, the study first compiled materials necessary for the chatbot to function as a Buddhist counseling tool and then recruited participants to interact with the chatbot, collecting feedback on their experiences.The development process of Cheongjeongmaeumbot involved constructing a counseling scenario and organizing materials for diagnosing defilements and providing solutions. The Buddhist counseling process was based on the traditional Four Noble Truths counseling model but was adapted to fit the unique environment of a chatbot and the specificity of clients seeking to resolve issues through immediate and efficient consultation. The focus was placed primarily on the diagnostic (dukkha) and solution (magga) stages.The diagnostic materials were organized around five primary defilements. Cheongjeongmaeumbot aims to identify and reduce common defilements at a general level, refining the five categories into 16 defilements based on scriptures and previous studies applying defilements to counseling. The defilement removal techniques were developed using contemporary counseling psychology techniques inspired by Buddhist principles, with a total of 20 techniques established.The evaluation of client experiences confirmed the feasibility of Cheongjeongmaeumbot and identified areas for improvement. The recommended improvements include: 1) establishing clear criteria for diagnosing defilements; 2) exploring methods for solution delivery in the unique chatbot environment; and 3) integrating these elements into a cohesive counseling process for a practical Buddhist counseling chatbot.

articles.title_kr: 트라우마 치유를 통한 마음의 변화 메커니즘 연구 - 성장치유모델을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: Study on the Mechanism of Mind Change through Trauma Healing - Focusing on the Growth Healing Model -
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 마음의 상처를 의미하는 트라우마(trauma) 증상을 치유하기 위해, 대승불교 유식학에서 도출한 성장치유모델을 제안하고 그 현대적 유용성을 탐색하였다. 성장치유모델은 트라우마 증상을 극복하는 과정을 단지 치료가 아니라 성장의 과정으로 보는 관점에서 제안된 것이다.이를 위해 필자는 트라우마 증상이 고통의 원인이 된다는 점에서 트라우마를 번뇌로 보고, 유식학에서 분류한 번뇌의 종류 가운데 트라우마 주요 증상에 해당하는 분노[진(瞋)], 불안[도거(掉擧)], 우울[혼침(昏沈)]에 주목하였다. 그리고 유식학의 수행오위(修行五位)를 기반으로 성장치유모델을 구성하였다.성장치유모델은 3단계로서 첫째, 선심소(善心所)의 함양, 둘째, 사심사관(四尋伺觀)과 사여실지관(四如實智觀)을 통한 마음의 상처치유, 셋째, 마음의 질적인 변화 등으로 이루어져 있다.제1단계인 선심소의 함양에서는 자비심을 통한 분노의 다스림, 평정심을 통한 불안의 다스림, 가볍고 편안함을 통한 우울의 다스림에 주목하여 실천방법을 제안하였다. 제2단계에서는 사심사관과 사여실지관을 적용하여 트라우마 증상인 분노, 불안, 우울과 같은 부정적 정서의 본질을 정확하게 통찰하고, 소멸하는 메커니즘과 실천방법을 제시하였다. 이어서 제3단계인 가행위(加行位)에서 통달위(通達位)에 이르는 과정을 트라우마를 극복하는 마음의 질적인 변화[전의(轉依)]로 해석하고 그것을 확인하는 방법을 제안하였다.필자는 이 논의를 토대로 서양의 ‘외상 후 성장’과 성장치유모델을 비교하여, 성장치유모델이 근원적으로 트라우마 증상을 치유하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음을 주장하였다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a growth healing model derived from Yogācāra Buddhism to heal the symptoms of trauma and explores its modern availability. I offered the healing model as a process of growth, not just treatment of trauma symptoms.I considered trauma as anguish in that trauma symptoms are the cause of the pain, and paid attention to the anger (dveṣa), anxiety (auddhatya) and depression (styāna), which are the main symptoms of trauma. In addition, I constructed a growth healing model based on the five practice stage of Yogācāra Buddhism.It consists of three stages: first, cultivation of the good function of mind (kuśala-caitta), second, healing the mind through ‘four kinds of investigation’ and ‘four kinds of enlightenment,’ third, radical conversion of mind.In the first stage, I suggested a method of practice, paying attention to the control of anger through mercy, anxiety through equanimity (upekṣā), and depression through relaxation (praśrabdhi).In the second stage, I revealed the mechanism of ceasing the negative emotion such as anger, anxiety and depression through ‘four kinds of investigation’ and ‘four kinds of enlightenment’.In the third stage, I explained the process from the stage of added effort to that of no-leaking as the radical conversion of mind. And I suggested a way to check that state of mind.Based on this discussion, I compared the growth healing model with the post-traumatic growth. And I proposed that the growth healing model can fundamentally help heal trauma symptoms.

articles.title_kr: 기도가피에 대한 동곡 일타의 관점
articles.title_en: Ven. Ilta’s Perspective on Adhiṣṭhāna in Prayers
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines the characteristics and significance of Ven. Donggok Ilta(東谷日陀)’s perspective on Adhiṣṭhāna in prayer. By analyzing the prayer-fulfilling mechanism, the study seeks to elucidate his unique understanding and practical approach to Adhiṣṭhāna in prayer.In Section Ⅱ, the background is investigated. Two main factors influenced his perspective. The first was his personal experiences of events associated with prayer throughout his life. The second was his role as a leader in the Korean Buddhist samgha during a period of conflicting views on prayer practices.In section Ⅲ, the mechanism of prayer-fulfillment as presented by Ven. Ilta is analyzed. At first, preconditions for prayer fulfillment. He emphasized two essential things-minds in prayer and key Buddhist prayers. The second, an analysis of the prayer- fulfilling mechanism he presented. The third, the characteristics and significance of the perspective on Ven. Ilta’s Adhiṣṭhāna of prayer.Ven. Ilta’s perspective on Adhiṣṭhāna of prayer challenges the traditional understanding of it as solely dependent on external ones. Instead, he redefined prayer as a dynamic interaction between the practitioner’s inner effort and the compassionate vows of Buddhas or Bodhisattvas. His views illuminate how prayer, while addressing worldly needs, can also serve as a gateway to transcendental realization.

articles.title_kr: 나말여초 불사의 성격과 한계 – 선사의 비문을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Nature and Limitations of the Late Shilla Early Corea – Focusing on Zen Master’s Inscriptions -
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines the characteristics and the limitations of Silla Buddhist Temple in the 9th and 10th centuries. Based on the analysis of Seonjong (Korean Zen meditation School) master’s inscriptions from late Silla to early Goryeo, the following conclusions are reached. First, the state authorized Silla inscriptions are primary historical materials, which show contemporary situations and descriptions of building Buddhist Temple. Second, during the 9th century, only a few Silla Zen monks who began residing at Hwaeom Temple – Gyojong, doctrinal school – established or rebuilt later a Seonjong temple. Third, during the late Silla and early Goryeo period of turmoil, spanning 50 years between the establishment of Later Baekje in 892 and the unification of Goryeo in 936, it is not yet known the record of large-scale Buddhist Temple in the literature. It allows to draw a conclusion that massive Buddhist Temples including the Buddhist statues and the pagodas could not be built or rebuilt in chaos caused by war. In a nutshell, this study introduces the several features and the scope of building Buddhist Temple in the 9th century and the period from late Shilla to early Goryeo by examining contemporary inscriptions. However, this study has limitations as follows: the lack of analysis of the Goryeo Buddhist statues and the pagodas after the unification of the Later Three States and the establishment of Goryeo in 936, in comparison with those during the 9th century and during the period from late Silla to early Goryeo. Hence, future study should be devoted to clarify the characteristics of the Goryeo Buddhist Temples after Goryeo’s unification in 936, compared with those during the 9th century and during the period from late Silla to early Goryeo, based on the conclusion of this study.

articles.title_kr: 염불선과 비움에 관한 고찰 - 불성과의 공명을 위한 ‘비움의 소리’ -
articles.title_en: A Study on the Chanting of the Buddha and Emptiness - ‘The Sound of Emptiness’ for Resonance with Buddhahood -
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines the principles of practicing Yeombulseon(念佛禪), focusing on the concept of ‘emptiness.’ ‘Emptiness’ is an important element in religious practice across cultures. Christianity emphasizes self-emptying in order to unite with God, and Buddhism also emphasizes non-self (無我), emptiness (空), and non-form (無相), and the core of practice is emptying karma (業力) and ego (我相).Repeated religious chanting is a religious practice commonly found in both the East and the West. Representative examples include the Jesus Prayer in Christianity, the Dhikr in Islam, the mantra in Hinduism, and the Yeombulseon in Buddhism, and they share similarities in that they seek to experience transformed consciousness and discover divinity through chanting.Practicing Yeombulseon is a process of emptying. When you repeatedly chant the names of the Buddha and Bodhisattvas out loud, your breathing slows down, your metabolism and brain waves stabilize, and your body’s tension is emptied. In addition, highly focused activities empty distracting thoughts, reduce mind wandering, and reduce motivation to react to negative emotions, thereby emptying the mind of attachments. When the mind and body are emptied in this way, the ego’s intentions are erased, deautomatization occurs that reverses automatic thinking, and a state of transformed consciousness that transcends the ego and is distinct from everyday consciousness is achieved, and the ego is also emptied. Ultimately, complete emptiness leads to the original empty and pure mind and resonates with our original nature, Buddha nature. Therefore, the sound of chanting based on faith, which is the most important element for complete emptiness, is the ‘sound of emptiness’ for complete emptiness, and chanting with one mind is an encounter with Buddha nature, the object of chanting, and resonance with Buddha nature.

articles.title_kr: 죽음을 선택할 권리 - 불교는 안락사를 정당화할 수 있는가? -
articles.title_en: The Right to Choose Death - Can Buddhism Justify Euthanasia? -
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 불교의 전통적 생명윤리 관점에서 안락사 문제를 재조명하고, 현대 의료 기술 발전에 따른 새로운 해석 가능성을 탐구한다. 전통적으로 불교는 불살생 계율에 따라 안락사를 부정적으로 보았으나, 현대 의학의 발전으로 무의미한 연명치료와 환자의 삶의 질 문제가 대두되면서 새로운 윤리적 고민이 필요해졌다.이에 본 논문은 계율의 재해석 가능성, 불살생계와 고통 경감의 관계, 업의 가변성과 개인의 자율성 측면에서 안락사에 대한 불교적 정당화를 시도한다. 특히 극심한 고통 속에서 회복 가능성이 없는 환자의 경우, 무조건적 생명 연장보다는 자비의 실천으로서 제한적 안락사가 허용될 수 있다고 본다.불교의 무상과 중도 사상에 비추어볼 때, 죽음은 삶의 자연스러운 흐름의 일부이며, 과도한 집착이나 극단적 태도를 지양해야 한다. 따라서 안락사는 환자의 고통, 회복 가능성, 자율성을 종합적으로 고려하여 중도적 관점에서 접근해야 하며, 이는 불교의 자비 정신과 현대 의료윤리의 조화로운 해석이 될 수 있다.

articles.title_kr: 고려 밀교 진언 신앙의 실례 - 광주 자운사 목조아미타여래좌상 복장 다라니 -
articles.title_en: Examples of Esoteric Buddhism Mantra Faith in the Koryo Dynasty - A Study on the Dhāraṇī from the Seated Wooden Amitabha Buddha Statue of Jawun-Sa Temple in Gwangju -
articles.abstract_kr: This study aims to shed light on the internal structures of the three dhāraṇīs found in the Seated Wooden Amitabha Buddha Statue of Jawun-sa Temple in Gwangju. The study first showed that “Ruyi bao yin da suiqiu tuoluoni fanzi juntuoluo xiang” (如意寶印大隨求陁羅尼 梵字 軍陁羅相) was made by altering the version published in China during the Tang Dynasty. The study also found that the icons of 32 majestic articles for ornamentation in the dhāraṇī materialized the norms related to the writing or establishment of the altar in the dhāraṇī of th Pubian guangming qingjing chisheng ruyi bao yin xin wuneng sheng de mingwang da suí suiqiu tuoluoni jing (普遍光明清淨熾盛如意寶印心無能勝大明王大隨求陀羅尼經).The investigator corrected the name of Ratnakarandaka Dhāraṇī that previously studies mistakenly indentiride as the Dhāraṇī of Twelve Heavens (十二天曼茶羅) or the Mantra of Three Bodies (三身眞言) in previous studies and explained the principle by which the letter Ah (, 阿) in the seed syllable of Vairocana Buddha was used at the center of Mantra of the Precious Casket Seal of the Complete-Body Relics of All Tathagatas. The study also found an example of conveying a recitation norm for mantras in the perimeter of the dhāraṇī, identifying the norm of mantra recitation practiced during the Koryo period.In addition, the study analyzed the 11 kinds of mantras in “Zhenyan wujincang zhenyan deng shu dao zhenyan zi lun” (眞言無盡藏眞言等數道眞言字輪) and found out the wishes and orientations of people in those days based on the examples of a dhāraṇī being mixed with several mantras.

articles.title_kr: 표훈(表訓)의 사상과 수행 체계 - 「표훈대덕발원문」의 재검토를 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Thought and Practice System of Pyohun (表訓) -Through Reexamination of Pyohun’s Prayer Text  (表訓大德發願文)-
articles.abstract_kr: This paper analyzed the thought and practice system on Pyohun after reviewing preceding research of Pyohun’s Prayer Text.Pyohun’s text was written for the purpose of embracing Trīṇi yānāni(三乘) from standpoint of Ekayāna(一乘). The Uisang school agonized about enlightening the ignorant of Trīṇi yānāni and ordinary persons. Pyohun participated in agony of his teacher Uisang and he was interested in ‘Jinseong’(genuineness) of the individual. Ordinary person can fine enlightenment through practicing the eighth consciousness called ‘Ālayavijñāna’. It is presumed that there is a wish to pursue the truth of buddhahood in Ālayavijñāna. Pyohun establishes a system of his own ideas through ‘Jinseong’(眞性, genuineness), ‘Ojongsaengmyeol’(五種生滅, five cases of birth and death), ‘Ogwanseok’(五觀釋, five methods of vipassana), ‘Samanui’(四滿義, four satisfactions), ‘Sambonjeong’(三本定, three fundamental Samādhi). ‘Wonseongyeoljeong’(願善決定, a determined wish) is very important concept for Pyohun. It implies that the scope of his faith and though extends beyond individual enligh tenment to altruism. Ogwanseok seems to be a system of vipassana that are presented to practitioners at each level. It is not a discriminatory and sequential system. If we practice by relying on Ogwanseok, we will directly attain the enlightenment of Ekayāna.Pyohun preached Samanui for the unwavering conviction of Buddhist practitioners. ‘Muju’(無住, non-stay) is a important theory in his thought and practice system. For Pyohun, Muju is our body and mind, which leads to the realm of our nature and our Buddha-nature.

articles.title_kr: 자비의 본성과 훈련 가능성에 대한 고찰 - 불교와 신경과학의 관점을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Nature and Trainability of Compassion - A Comparative Exploration of Buddhist and  Neuroscientific Perspectives -
articles.abstract_kr: This study investigates whether compassion is an innate human quality or a psychological capacity that can be cultivated through training, by comparing perspectives from Buddhist traditions— particularly those grounded in Tathāgatagarbha thought, Yogācāra, and Madhyamaka—with insights from contemporary science. In Buddhist philosophy, compassion is intimately connected with bodhicitta, the foundational motivation of the bodhisattva path.In contrast, evolutionary psychology and neuroscience concep tualize compassion as an adaptive trait that evolved to support survival and social cooperation. Recent scientific findings—such as those concerning neuroplasticity, oxytocin, the vagus nerve, and the default mode network—demonstrate that compassion is a trainable capacity with measurable psychological and physiological effects.This comparative inquiry suggests that traditional Buddhist compassion practices can be reinterpreted through the language of modern science, thereby opening possibilities for an integrated understanding at the intersection of ethics, contemplative training, and empirical research. Today, compassion is increasingly recognized not only as a latent human potential but also as a developable skill that offers a vital resource for healing and connection. At the same time, scientific accounts that disregard the doctrinal and experiential depth of Buddhist traditions risk reducing or distorting the true significance of compassion. Thus, a meaningful interdisciplinary understanding of compassion must rest on a thorough engagement with the philosophical context within which it is embedded. This paper proposes a theoretical groundwork for such integrative dialogue.

articles.title_kr: 좌선 자세 교육의 효과에 관한 연구
articles.title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness of Sitting Meditation  Posture Education
articles.abstract_kr: This study aims to verify the effectiveness and necessity of sitting meditation posture education. To achieve this, a quantitative and qualitative analysis was conducted through surveys and interviews with 117 participants in the Seon meditation program at the Heungguksa Temple-Stay in Goyang. The research findings are as follows: First, an analysis of the effects of the sitting meditation posture revealed that its four core elements contributed to forming proper alignment of the lumbar, thoracic, and cervical spine, as well as the entire body. This, in turn, facilitated smooth breathing, enhancing stability, comfort, and concentration. The average score for evaluation factors exceeded 8.5, indicating high satisfaction, although some discomfort in maintaining the posture persisted. Second, a comparison between experienced and inexperi enced participants showed that experienced practitioners reported reduced discomfort, deeper and longer breaths, and greater relaxation and concentration. They gained a clearer understanding of posture mechanics through education, identified their issues, and improved their practice accordingly. Third, an analysis of the effectiveness of sitting meditation posture education showed a satisfaction score of 9.4. Participants understood the principles and significance of posture and breathing, experienced physiological changes linked to posture adjustments, and recognized the necessity of ongoing education and specialized meditation programs. By confirming the effectiveness of sitting meditation posture education, this study reaffirms its importance and necessity, providing practitioners with an effective approach to meditation.

articles.title_kr: 『염불보권문』을 통해 본 한국불교 염불신앙의 확산과 의미
articles.title_en: The Spread and Significance of Korean Buddhist Yeombul Practice(念佛信仰) as Seen Through the 『Yeombul Bogwonmun』(念佛普勸文)
articles.abstract_kr: The purpose of this study is to explore the religious meaning and value of “Yeombul” (念佛) practice, which has become a representative faith in Korean Buddhism, and to suggest a direction for the future of modern Buddhism. Today, “Yeombul” practice inherits the tradition of the late Joseon Dynasty, and the Yeombul Bogwonmun (『念佛普勸文』), a key “Yeombul” text from the 18th century, is closely related to this tradition.While previous “Yeombul” texts focused on the Pure Land doctrines or the Seon-and-Pure Land perspectives, the Yeombul Bogwonmun emphasizes miraculous merits (神異的 加被) for rebirth in the Pure Land after death and for obtaining blessings in the present life. This changed view of “Yeombul” practice became widespread throughout the nation during the late Joseon period, following the publication of the text. Although the chronological relationship between the shift in “Yeombul” perspective and the publication of the text remains unclear, it can be inferred that there was an organic connection between the two phenomena.Accordingly, this study analyzes the historical context and Buddhist trends of the period surrounding the publication of the Yeombul Bogwonmun and examines the faith and ideology contained within the book to compare the changes and characteristics of “Yeombul” practice in the late Joseon Dynasty. The findings reveal that the spread of “Yeombul” practice was a result of a combination of social roles, such as pacifying the public’s anxieties following the Imjin and Byeongja Wars, and religious goals like rebirth in the Pure Land and the salvation of all beings. Furthermore, it is identified as an evolution of Korean Buddhist practice that was established through internal ideological changes, such as the Sam-mun (Three Gates) training.In conclusion, this study aims to shed light on the changes and significance of “Yeombul” practice that developed during a period of repression, thereby providing important implications for the future direction of modern Korean Buddhism.

articles.title_kr: 간화선에서 스승의 중요성과 대중화의 문제 - 『선요』에 나타난 고봉 원묘의 수증 과정을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: Importance of Master in Ganhwaseon Practice and Challenge of Its Popularization - Focusing on Gaofeng Yuanmiao’s Experiences of Practice and Attainment Depicted in Chanyao -
articles.abstract_kr: In this study, I argue that the essence of Ganhwaseon is “practice guidance depending on one’s religious capability,” which may conflict with efforts to popularize Ganhwaseon within the contemporary Korean Buddhist order. To support this thesis, I outline the general perception of masters in Seon Buddhism and then review Gaofeng Yuanmiao (高峰原妙, 1238-1295)’s practicing process described in Chanyao (禪要, Essentials of Chan) to reexamine master’s role and importance in Ganhwaseon practice.The terms representing spiritual masters in the Seon sect, such as Josa (祖師, “patriarch”), Seonjisik (善知識, “virtuous teacher”), and Jongsa (宗師, “eminent master”), include meaning as an ideal character with an insight of enlightenment beyond any discrimination. The masters employ various methods and instruct their disciples to experience enlightenment firsthand.Some texts in Chanyao provide a detailed description of this type of master’s practice guidance. Gaofeng concentrated on hwadu under the instruction of two masters, Duanqiao Miaolun (斷橋妙倫, 1201-1261) and Xueyan Zuqin (雪巖祖欽, 1215-1287), and in particular, Xueyan played a decisive role throughout Gaofeng’s practice. He presented a new hwadu to Gaofeng and encouraged him through continuous inspection. Once Gaofeng experienced enlightenment later, Xueyan formally approved the disciple’s attainment. This demonstrates how a master accurately assesses a disciple’s capabilities and provides guidance, highlighting the crucial role of the master’s guidance in Ganhwaseon.However, there is a concern that the individual-specific guidance method of the traditional Ganhwaseon could decline due to popularization, which is aimed at an unspecified population. Prior to popularization, it seems necessary to revitalize the function of master’s practice guidance and find a way to bridge the gap between the two. In that sense, addressing the issues raised in this study can help determine the direction of Ganhwaseon’s popularization.

articles.title_kr: 유가행중관파 형상이론에 대한 쫑카파와 현대 해석의 비교 연구
articles.title_en: Comparative Interpretations of the Theory of Appearances in Yogācāra-Madhyamaka: Tsong kha pa and Modern Perspectives
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examines the philosophical implications and interpretative issues surrounding Śāntarakṣita’s theory of appearances (ākāra) within the context of Late Madhyamaka thought. Śāntarakṣita, a key figure in the synthesis of Madhyamaka and Yogācāra, developed a refined theory of the relationship between existence and cognition, integrating the doctrine of emptiness with Yogācāra epistemology. His ekānekasvabhāvaviyoga (the exclusion of singular and plural natures) argument offers a new methodological approach to demonstrating the absence of inherent existence. He also presents a dual-layered view of conventional truth, distinguishing between “true conventionality” and “false conventionality,” the former grounded in causal efficacy and the latter in conceptual fabrication. Although this position closely parallels Bhāviveka’s view of conventionality, Śāntarakṣita has often been classified as a proponent of the “Yogācāra- Madhyamaka” school that denies external objects.Matsumoto Shiro challenges this classification by interpreting the 64th verse of Śāntarakṣita’s Madhyamakālaṃkāra and its commentary as affirming the existence of external forms (rūpa, ākāra) on a conventional level, thereby criticizing Tsong kha pa’s later interpretation, which emphasizes the absence of external objects even conventionally.This study, therefore, pursues three aims: first, to critically analyze Śāntarakṣita’s theory of appearances; second, to explore Tsong kha pa’s interpretation of this theory within the framework of ākāra-realism; and third, to evaluate Matsumoto’s critique in light of broader contemporary Buddhist scholarship. Through this inquiry, the paper seeks to reconstruct the complex hermeneutical landscape regarding the status of appearances in Madhyamaka philosophy.

articles.title_kr: 이제설의 전개 양상과 철학적 의미 탐색 - 초기불교에서 『중론』까지 -
articles.title_en: An Inquiry into the Development and Philosophical Meaning of the Two Truths Doctrine - From Early Buddhism to the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā -
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examines the historical development of the doctrine of the Two Truths (二諦說) from Early Buddhism to Nāgārjuna’s Mūlamadhyamakakārikā, highlighting its philosophical significance in relation to language, truth, cognition, and liberation. While Early Buddhism does not explicitly distinguish between conventional and ultimate truths, a dual structure implicitly operates through the contrast between nirvāṇa and conditioned phenomena, as well as through the tension between linguistic expression and existential intuition. The Abhidharma schools systematized this structure within a substantialist metaphysics, identifying conventional truth with linguistic constructs and ultimate truth with intrinsic reality. Language was thus regarded as a reliable means of conveying truth, and an epistemology developed that sought ultimate insight through refined conceptual analysis. In contrast, the Prajñāpāramitā scriptures critically dismantle this realist framework, undermining both the notion of intrinsic nature (svabhāva) and the trust in language itself. These texts argue that language cannot convey ultimate truth and propose a reinterpretation of the Two Truths centered on emptiness (śūnyatā) and skillful means (upāya). Building on this critique, Nāgārjuna inherits and systematizes these insights in the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā, articulating the dependent and empty nature of all phenomena and establishing the interdependence of conventional and ultimate truths. While language cannot directly express truth, it can serve a pragmatic, soteriological role within the conditioned world. By interlinking dependent origination, emptiness, nominal designation, and the Middle Way, Nāgārjuna transforms the Two Truths from a doctrinal dichotomy into a dynamic framework for reflecting on language and reality, cognition and practice. This philosophical model laid the foundation for later developments in Madhyamaka thought by Bhāviveka and Candrakīrti, ultimately demonstrating the doctrine’s pivotal role in Buddhism’s linguistic and philosophical turn.

articles.title_kr: 불교의 계율에서 본 심신장애의 윤리적 책임성에 대한 고찰 - 한역 율장 및 『범망경』 주석 전통의 시각에서 -
articles.title_en: A Study into the Moral Responsibility of Agents with Mental Disabilities in the Buddhist Precepts - From the Perspective of the Chinese Vinaya Translations and the Commentarial Tradition on the Brahmāʼs Net Sūtra(Brahmajāla Sūtra) -
articles.abstract_kr: This study scrutinizes the Buddhist Vinaya’s stance on the moral responsibility of agents with mental disabilities through the prism of Article 10 of the Criminal Code, which differentiates among “insanity,” “temporary insanity,” and the doctrine of “actio libera in causa.” The first two legal rubrics correspond to the Vinaya designations chikuang (癡狂, madness) and xinluan (心亂, mental turbulence). Drawing on the Nanti (Nandika; 難提) and Bozhenanti (鉢遮難提) cases preserved in the Mahāsāṃghika Vinaya, the text pronounces non-guilt whenever intention is absent and memory inaccessible owing to such impairment.The Vinayas also canvass scenarios analogous to actio libera in causa, in which an agent deliberately annihilates her own capacity for culpability before the offense. A salient example appears in the Sarvāstivādavinayamātṛkā: an agent, having engineered her slumber, causes her mother’s death; because the homicidal purpose was fully formed during preparation, the act is classified as a Pārājika offense—the gravest transgression. The Dharmaguptaka Vinaya’s doctrine of yifa (倚發) further bifurcates the inception of criminal intent from the act’s consummation.Within the Brahmāʼs Net Sūtra, mens rea likewise constitutes the decisive touchstone for major offenses. Interpretations, however, diverge over the notion of cause (因). Wonhyo (元曉) restricts the “direct cause” to specific criminal intent, foregrounding the agent’s psychological state as the primary yardstick of responsibility. Seungjang (勝莊), by contrast, subsumes under the direct cause both concrete desire (欲樂) and the defilements of greed, hatred, and delusion, yielding a more expansive attribution of blame.Thus the Buddhist precepts adjudicates culpability by calibrating intention against mental condition—a hermeneutic with constructive implications for Buddhist ethics and legal philosophy.

articles.title_kr: 한국불교와 범패(梵唄)의 역사 - 신라‧고려 시대 금석문을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: A Study on Bumpae in the History of Korean Buddhism - Focusing on the Inscriptions of Silla and Goryeo -
articles.abstract_kr: This study is a review of the Bumpae among intangible cultural properties. In particular, I wanted to examine the a real image of the Bumpae in the history of Korean Buddhism during the Silla and the Goryeo Dynasty.During the Silla period, the introduction and propagation of Dangpung Bumpae are closely associated with Jingam Seonsa(眞鑑禪師). Historical evidence suggests that Dangpung Bumpae was introduced around the reign of King Gyeongdeok, a time marked by increased cultural and religious exchanges with Dang(唐). As the Silla royal court came to emphasize Buddhist ceremonies, the practice of Bumpae flourished accordingly. By the reign of King Gyeongmun and especially toward the end of the Silla dynasty, Bumpae had become a widely practiced and popular ritual element.During the Goryeo Dynasty, Bumpae functioned as a core element of ritual music in state-sponsored Buddhist ceremonies, much like in the Silla Dynasty. Beyond its liturgical function, it also fulfilled significant social roles, such as promoting national security, ensuring political stability, and serving as a means of public consolation. Bumpae was not limited to royal ceremonies; it was also widely practiced in temple ceremonies and Buddihist daliy life. In particular, epigraphic records and biographies of monks often portray Bumpae as a symbolic medium that expressed the spiritual connection between the Sangha and Buddhism.Moreover, Bumpae operated as a practical form of Buddhist expression that the general public could directly experience and participate in. This reveals that in Goryeo society, Bumpae was regarded not only as the sacred sound of Buddhism but also as a popular musical form of religious faith. Consequently, Bumpae played a crucial role in the popularization of Buddhism, eventually securing an important place within the broader landscape of Korean Buddhist culture.
