112권 호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 마음의 상처를 의미하는 트라우마(trauma) 증상을 치유하기 위해, 대승불교 유식학에서 도출한 성장치유모델을 제안하고 그 현대적 유용성을 탐색하였다. 성장치유모델은 트라우마 증상을 극복하는 과정을 단지 치료가 아니라 성장의 과정으로 보는 관점에서 제안된 것이다.이를 위해 필자는 트라우마 증상이 고통의 원인이 된다는 점에서 트라우마를 번뇌로 보고, 유식학에서 분류한 번뇌의 종류 가운데 트라우마 주요 증상에 해당하는 분노[진(瞋)], 불안[도거(掉擧)], 우울[혼침(昏沈)]에 주목하였다. 그리고 유식학의 수행오위(修行五位)를 기반으로 성장치유모델을 구성하였다.성장치유모델은 3단계로서 첫째, 선심소(善心所)의 함양, 둘째, 사심사관(四尋伺觀)과 사여실지관(四如實智觀)을 통한 마음의 상처치유, 셋째, 마음의 질적인 변화 등으로 이루어져 있다.제1단계인 선심소의 함양에서는 자비심을 통한 분노의 다스림, 평정심을 통한 불안의 다스림, 가볍고 편안함을 통한 우울의 다스림에 주목하여 실천방법을 제안하였다. 제2단계에서는 사심사관과 사여실지관을 적용하여 트라우마 증상인 분노, 불안, 우울과 같은 부정적 정서의 본질을 정확하게 통찰하고, 소멸하는 메커니즘과 실천방법을 제시하였다. 이어서 제3단계인 가행위(加行位)에서 통달위(通達位)에 이르는 과정을 트라우마를 극복하는 마음의 질적인 변화[전의(轉依)]로 해석하고 그것을 확인하는 방법을 제안하였다.필자는 이 논의를 토대로 서양의 ‘외상 후 성장’과 성장치유모델을 비교하여, 성장치유모델이 근원적으로 트라우마 증상을 치유하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음을 주장하였다.
112권 호.abstract_en: This paper proposes a growth healing model derived from Yogācāra Buddhism to heal the symptoms of trauma and explores its modern availability. I offered the healing model as a process of growth, not just treatment of trauma symptoms.I considered trauma as anguish in that trauma symptoms are the cause of the pain, and paid attention to the anger (dveṣa), anxiety (auddhatya) and depression (styāna), which are the main symptoms of trauma. In addition, I constructed a growth healing model based on the five practice stage of Yogācāra Buddhism.It consists of three stages: first, cultivation of the good function of mind (kuśala-caitta), second, healing the mind through ‘four kinds of investigation’ and ‘four kinds of enlightenment,’ third, radical conversion of mind.In the first stage, I suggested a method of practice, paying attention to the control of anger through mercy, anxiety through equanimity (upekṣā), and depression through relaxation (praśrabdhi).In the second stage, I revealed the mechanism of ceasing the negative emotion such as anger, anxiety and depression through ‘four kinds of investigation’ and ‘four kinds of enlightenment’.In the third stage, I explained the process from the stage of added effort to that of no-leaking as the radical conversion of mind. And I suggested a way to check that state of mind.Based on this discussion, I compared the growth healing model with the post-traumatic growth. And I proposed that the growth healing model can fundamentally help heal trauma symptoms.

113권 호.title_en: Ven. Ilta’s Perspective on Adhiṣṭhāna in Prayers
113권 호.abstract_kr: This study examines the characteristics and significance of Ven. Donggok Ilta(東谷日陀)’s perspective on Adhiṣṭhāna in prayer. By analyzing the prayer-fulfilling mechanism, the study seeks to elucidate his unique understanding and practical approach to Adhiṣṭhāna in prayer.In Section Ⅱ, the background is investigated. Two main factors influenced his perspective. The first was his personal experiences of events associated with prayer throughout his life. The second was his role as a leader in the Korean Buddhist samgha during a period of conflicting views on prayer practices.In section Ⅲ, the mechanism of prayer-fulfillment as presented by Ven. Ilta is analyzed. At first, preconditions for prayer fulfillment. He emphasized two essential things-minds in prayer and key Buddhist prayers. The second, an analysis of the prayer- fulfilling mechanism he presented. The third, the characteristics and significance of the perspective on Ven. Ilta’s Adhiṣṭhāna of prayer.Ven. Ilta’s perspective on Adhiṣṭhāna of prayer challenges the traditional understanding of it as solely dependent on external ones. Instead, he redefined prayer as a dynamic interaction between the practitioner’s inner effort and the compassionate vows of Buddhas or Bodhisattvas. His views illuminate how prayer, while addressing worldly needs, can also serve as a gateway to transcendental realization.

113권 호.title_kr: 나말여초 불사의 성격과 한계 – 선사의 비문을 중심으로 -
113권 호.title_en: The Nature and Limitations of the Late Shilla Early Corea – Focusing on Zen Master’s Inscriptions -
113권 호.abstract_kr: This study examines the characteristics and the limitations of Silla Buddhist Temple in the 9th and 10th centuries. Based on the analysis of Seonjong (Korean Zen meditation School) master’s inscriptions from late Silla to early Goryeo, the following conclusions are reached. First, the state authorized Silla inscriptions are primary historical materials, which show contemporary situations and descriptions of building Buddhist Temple. Second, during the 9th century, only a few Silla Zen monks who began residing at Hwaeom Temple – Gyojong, doctrinal school – established or rebuilt later a Seonjong temple. Third, during the late Silla and early Goryeo period of turmoil, spanning 50 years between the establishment of Later Baekje in 892 and the unification of Goryeo in 936, it is not yet known the record of large-scale Buddhist Temple in the literature. It allows to draw a conclusion that massive Buddhist Temples including the Buddhist statues and the pagodas could not be built or rebuilt in chaos caused by war. In a nutshell, this study introduces the several features and the scope of building Buddhist Temple in the 9th century and the period from late Shilla to early Goryeo by examining contemporary inscriptions. However, this study has limitations as follows: the lack of analysis of the Goryeo Buddhist statues and the pagodas after the unification of the Later Three States and the establishment of Goryeo in 936, in comparison with those during the 9th century and during the period from late Silla to early Goryeo. Hence, future study should be devoted to clarify the characteristics of the Goryeo Buddhist Temples after Goryeo’s unification in 936, compared with those during the 9th century and during the period from late Silla to early Goryeo, based on the conclusion of this study.

113권 호.title_kr: 염불선과 비움에 관한 고찰 - 불성과의 공명을 위한 ‘비움의 소리’ -
113권 호.title_en: A Study on the Chanting of the Buddha and Emptiness - ‘The Sound of Emptiness’ for Resonance with Buddhahood -
113권 호.abstract_kr: This study examines the principles of practicing Yeombulseon(念佛禪), focusing on the concept of ‘emptiness.’ ‘Emptiness’ is an important element in religious practice across cultures. Christianity emphasizes self-emptying in order to unite with God, and Buddhism also emphasizes non-self (無我), emptiness (空), and non-form (無相), and the core of practice is emptying karma (業力) and ego (我相).Repeated religious chanting is a religious practice commonly found in both the East and the West. Representative examples include the Jesus Prayer in Christianity, the Dhikr in Islam, the mantra in Hinduism, and the Yeombulseon in Buddhism, and they share similarities in that they seek to experience transformed consciousness and discover divinity through chanting.Practicing Yeombulseon is a process of emptying. When you repeatedly chant the names of the Buddha and Bodhisattvas out loud, your breathing slows down, your metabolism and brain waves stabilize, and your body’s tension is emptied. In addition, highly focused activities empty distracting thoughts, reduce mind wandering, and reduce motivation to react to negative emotions, thereby emptying the mind of attachments. When the mind and body are emptied in this way, the ego’s intentions are erased, deautomatization occurs that reverses automatic thinking, and a state of transformed consciousness that transcends the ego and is distinct from everyday consciousness is achieved, and the ego is also emptied. Ultimately, complete emptiness leads to the original empty and pure mind and resonates with our original nature, Buddha nature. Therefore, the sound of chanting based on faith, which is the most important element for complete emptiness, is the ‘sound of emptiness’ for complete emptiness, and chanting with one mind is an encounter with Buddha nature, the object of chanting, and resonance with Buddha nature.

113권 호.title_kr: 죽음을 선택할 권리 - 불교는 안락사를 정당화할 수 있는가? -
113권 호.title_en: The Right to Choose Death - Can Buddhism Justify Euthanasia? -
113권 호.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 불교의 전통적 생명윤리 관점에서 안락사 문제를 재조명하고, 현대 의료 기술 발전에 따른 새로운 해석 가능성을 탐구한다. 전통적으로 불교는 불살생 계율에 따라 안락사를 부정적으로 보았으나, 현대 의학의 발전으로 무의미한 연명치료와 환자의 삶의 질 문제가 대두되면서 새로운 윤리적 고민이 필요해졌다.이에 본 논문은 계율의 재해석 가능성, 불살생계와 고통 경감의 관계, 업의 가변성과 개인의 자율성 측면에서 안락사에 대한 불교적 정당화를 시도한다. 특히 극심한 고통 속에서 회복 가능성이 없는 환자의 경우, 무조건적 생명 연장보다는 자비의 실천으로서 제한적 안락사가 허용될 수 있다고 본다.불교의 무상과 중도 사상에 비추어볼 때, 죽음은 삶의 자연스러운 흐름의 일부이며, 과도한 집착이나 극단적 태도를 지양해야 한다. 따라서 안락사는 환자의 고통, 회복 가능성, 자율성을 종합적으로 고려하여 중도적 관점에서 접근해야 하며, 이는 불교의 자비 정신과 현대 의료윤리의 조화로운 해석이 될 수 있다.

113권 호.title_kr: 고려 밀교 진언 신앙의 실례 - 광주 자운사 목조아미타여래좌상 복장 다라니 -
113권 호.title_en: Examples of Esoteric Buddhism Mantra Faith in the Koryo Dynasty - A Study on the Dhāraṇī from the Seated Wooden Amitabha Buddha Statue of Jawun-Sa Temple in Gwangju -
113권 호.abstract_kr: This study aims to shed light on the internal structures of the three dhāraṇīs found in the Seated Wooden Amitabha Buddha Statue of Jawun-sa Temple in Gwangju. The study first showed that “Ruyi bao yin da suiqiu tuoluoni fanzi juntuoluo xiang” (如意寶印大隨求陁羅尼 梵字 軍陁羅相) was made by altering the version published in China during the Tang Dynasty. The study also found that the icons of 32 majestic articles for ornamentation in the dhāraṇī materialized the norms related to the writing or establishment of the altar in the dhāraṇī of th Pubian guangming qingjing chisheng ruyi bao yin xin wuneng sheng de mingwang da suí suiqiu tuoluoni jing (普遍光明清淨熾盛如意寶印心無能勝大明王大隨求陀羅尼經).The investigator corrected the name of Ratnakarandaka Dhāraṇī that previously studies mistakenly indentiride as the Dhāraṇī of Twelve Heavens (十二天曼茶羅) or the Mantra of Three Bodies (三身眞言) in previous studies and explained the principle by which the letter Ah (, 阿) in the seed syllable of Vairocana Buddha was used at the center of Mantra of the Precious Casket Seal of the Complete-Body Relics of All Tathagatas. The study also found an example of conveying a recitation norm for mantras in the perimeter of the dhāraṇī, identifying the norm of mantra recitation practiced during the Koryo period.In addition, the study analyzed the 11 kinds of mantras in “Zhenyan wujincang zhenyan deng shu dao zhenyan zi lun” (眞言無盡藏眞言等數道眞言字輪) and found out the wishes and orientations of people in those days based on the examples of a dhāraṇī being mixed with several mantras.

114권 호.title_kr: 표훈(表訓)의 사상과 수행 체계 - 「표훈대덕발원문」의 재검토를 중심으로 -
114권 호.title_en: The Thought and Practice System of Pyohun (表訓) -Through Reexamination of Pyohun’s Prayer Text  (表訓大德發願文)-
114권 호.abstract_kr: This paper analyzed the thought and practice system on Pyohun after reviewing preceding research of Pyohun’s Prayer Text.Pyohun’s text was written for the purpose of embracing Trīṇi yānāni(三乘) from standpoint of Ekayāna(一乘). The Uisang school agonized about enlightening the ignorant of Trīṇi yānāni and ordinary persons. Pyohun participated in agony of his teacher Uisang and he was interested in ‘Jinseong’(genuineness) of the individual. Ordinary person can fine enlightenment through practicing the eighth consciousness called ‘Ālayavijñāna’. It is presumed that there is a wish to pursue the truth of buddhahood in Ālayavijñāna. Pyohun establishes a system of his own ideas through ‘Jinseong’(眞性, genuineness), ‘Ojongsaengmyeol’(五種生滅, five cases of birth and death), ‘Ogwanseok’(五觀釋, five methods of vipassana), ‘Samanui’(四滿義, four satisfactions), ‘Sambonjeong’(三本定, three fundamental Samādhi). ‘Wonseongyeoljeong’(願善決定, a determined wish) is very important concept for Pyohun. It implies that the scope of his faith and though extends beyond individual enligh tenment to altruism. Ogwanseok seems to be a system of vipassana that are presented to practitioners at each level. It is not a discriminatory and sequential system. If we practice by relying on Ogwanseok, we will directly attain the enlightenment of Ekayāna.Pyohun preached Samanui for the unwavering conviction of Buddhist practitioners. ‘Muju’(無住, non-stay) is a important theory in his thought and practice system. For Pyohun, Muju is our body and mind, which leads to the realm of our nature and our Buddha-nature.

114권 호.title_kr: 자비의 본성과 훈련 가능성에 대한 고찰 - 불교와 신경과학의 관점을 중심으로 -
114권 호.title_en: The Nature and Trainability of Compassion - A Comparative Exploration of Buddhist and  Neuroscientific Perspectives -
114권 호.abstract_kr: This study investigates whether compassion is an innate human quality or a psychological capacity that can be cultivated through training, by comparing perspectives from Buddhist traditions— particularly those grounded in Tathāgatagarbha thought, Yogācāra, and Madhyamaka—with insights from contemporary science. In Buddhist philosophy, compassion is intimately connected with bodhicitta, the foundational motivation of the bodhisattva path.In contrast, evolutionary psychology and neuroscience concep tualize compassion as an adaptive trait that evolved to support survival and social cooperation. Recent scientific findings—such as those concerning neuroplasticity, oxytocin, the vagus nerve, and the default mode network—demonstrate that compassion is a trainable capacity with measurable psychological and physiological effects.This comparative inquiry suggests that traditional Buddhist compassion practices can be reinterpreted through the language of modern science, thereby opening possibilities for an integrated understanding at the intersection of ethics, contemplative training, and empirical research. Today, compassion is increasingly recognized not only as a latent human potential but also as a developable skill that offers a vital resource for healing and connection. At the same time, scientific accounts that disregard the doctrinal and experiential depth of Buddhist traditions risk reducing or distorting the true significance of compassion. Thus, a meaningful interdisciplinary understanding of compassion must rest on a thorough engagement with the philosophical context within which it is embedded. This paper proposes a theoretical groundwork for such integrative dialogue.

114권 호.title_kr: 좌선 자세 교육의 효과에 관한 연구
114권 호.title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness of Sitting Meditation  Posture Education
114권 호.abstract_kr: This study aims to verify the effectiveness and necessity of sitting meditation posture education. To achieve this, a quantitative and qualitative analysis was conducted through surveys and interviews with 117 participants in the Seon meditation program at the Heungguksa Temple-Stay in Goyang. The research findings are as follows: First, an analysis of the effects of the sitting meditation posture revealed that its four core elements contributed to forming proper alignment of the lumbar, thoracic, and cervical spine, as well as the entire body. This, in turn, facilitated smooth breathing, enhancing stability, comfort, and concentration. The average score for evaluation factors exceeded 8.5, indicating high satisfaction, although some discomfort in maintaining the posture persisted. Second, a comparison between experienced and inexperi enced participants showed that experienced practitioners reported reduced discomfort, deeper and longer breaths, and greater relaxation and concentration. They gained a clearer understanding of posture mechanics through education, identified their issues, and improved their practice accordingly. Third, an analysis of the effectiveness of sitting meditation posture education showed a satisfaction score of 9.4. Participants understood the principles and significance of posture and breathing, experienced physiological changes linked to posture adjustments, and recognized the necessity of ongoing education and specialized meditation programs. By confirming the effectiveness of sitting meditation posture education, this study reaffirms its importance and necessity, providing practitioners with an effective approach to meditation.

115권 호.title_kr: 『염불보권문』을 통해 본 한국불교 염불신앙의 확산과 의미
115권 호.title_en: The Spread and Significance of Korean Buddhist Yeombul Practice(念佛信仰) as Seen Through the 『Yeombul Bogwonmun』(念佛普勸文)
115권 호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this study is to explore the religious meaning and value of “Yeombul” (念佛) practice, which has become a representative faith in Korean Buddhism, and to suggest a direction for the future of modern Buddhism. Today, “Yeombul” practice inherits the tradition of the late Joseon Dynasty, and the Yeombul Bogwonmun (『念佛普勸文』), a key “Yeombul” text from the 18th century, is closely related to this tradition.While previous “Yeombul” texts focused on the Pure Land doctrines or the Seon-and-Pure Land perspectives, the Yeombul Bogwonmun emphasizes miraculous merits (神異的 加被) for rebirth in the Pure Land after death and for obtaining blessings in the present life. This changed view of “Yeombul” practice became widespread throughout the nation during the late Joseon period, following the publication of the text. Although the chronological relationship between the shift in “Yeombul” perspective and the publication of the text remains unclear, it can be inferred that there was an organic connection between the two phenomena.Accordingly, this study analyzes the historical context and Buddhist trends of the period surrounding the publication of the Yeombul Bogwonmun and examines the faith and ideology contained within the book to compare the changes and characteristics of “Yeombul” practice in the late Joseon Dynasty. The findings reveal that the spread of “Yeombul” practice was a result of a combination of social roles, such as pacifying the public’s anxieties following the Imjin and Byeongja Wars, and religious goals like rebirth in the Pure Land and the salvation of all beings. Furthermore, it is identified as an evolution of Korean Buddhist practice that was established through internal ideological changes, such as the Sam-mun (Three Gates) training.In conclusion, this study aims to shed light on the changes and significance of “Yeombul” practice that developed during a period of repression, thereby providing important implications for the future direction of modern Korean Buddhism.

115권 호.title_kr: 간화선에서 스승의 중요성과 대중화의 문제 - 『선요』에 나타난 고봉 원묘의 수증 과정을 중심으로 -
115권 호.title_en: Importance of Master in Ganhwaseon Practice and Challenge of Its Popularization - Focusing on Gaofeng Yuanmiao’s Experiences of Practice and Attainment Depicted in Chanyao -
115권 호.abstract_kr: In this study, I argue that the essence of Ganhwaseon is “practice guidance depending on one’s religious capability,” which may conflict with efforts to popularize Ganhwaseon within the contemporary Korean Buddhist order. To support this thesis, I outline the general perception of masters in Seon Buddhism and then review Gaofeng Yuanmiao (高峰原妙, 1238-1295)’s practicing process described in Chanyao (禪要, Essentials of Chan) to reexamine master’s role and importance in Ganhwaseon practice.The terms representing spiritual masters in the Seon sect, such as Josa (祖師, “patriarch”), Seonjisik (善知識, “virtuous teacher”), and Jongsa (宗師, “eminent master”), include meaning as an ideal character with an insight of enlightenment beyond any discrimination. The masters employ various methods and instruct their disciples to experience enlightenment firsthand.Some texts in Chanyao provide a detailed description of this type of master’s practice guidance. Gaofeng concentrated on hwadu under the instruction of two masters, Duanqiao Miaolun (斷橋妙倫, 1201-1261) and Xueyan Zuqin (雪巖祖欽, 1215-1287), and in particular, Xueyan played a decisive role throughout Gaofeng’s practice. He presented a new hwadu to Gaofeng and encouraged him through continuous inspection. Once Gaofeng experienced enlightenment later, Xueyan formally approved the disciple’s attainment. This demonstrates how a master accurately assesses a disciple’s capabilities and provides guidance, highlighting the crucial role of the master’s guidance in Ganhwaseon.However, there is a concern that the individual-specific guidance method of the traditional Ganhwaseon could decline due to popularization, which is aimed at an unspecified population. Prior to popularization, it seems necessary to revitalize the function of master’s practice guidance and find a way to bridge the gap between the two. In that sense, addressing the issues raised in this study can help determine the direction of Ganhwaseon’s popularization.

115권 호.title_kr: 유가행중관파 형상이론에 대한 쫑카파와 현대 해석의 비교 연구
115권 호.title_en: Comparative Interpretations of the Theory of Appearances in Yogācāra-Madhyamaka: Tsong kha pa and Modern Perspectives
115권 호.abstract_kr: This paper examines the philosophical implications and interpretative issues surrounding Śāntarakṣita’s theory of appearances (ākāra) within the context of Late Madhyamaka thought. Śāntarakṣita, a key figure in the synthesis of Madhyamaka and Yogācāra, developed a refined theory of the relationship between existence and cognition, integrating the doctrine of emptiness with Yogācāra epistemology. His ekānekasvabhāvaviyoga (the exclusion of singular and plural natures) argument offers a new methodological approach to demonstrating the absence of inherent existence. He also presents a dual-layered view of conventional truth, distinguishing between “true conventionality” and “false conventionality,” the former grounded in causal efficacy and the latter in conceptual fabrication. Although this position closely parallels Bhāviveka’s view of conventionality, Śāntarakṣita has often been classified as a proponent of the “Yogācāra- Madhyamaka” school that denies external objects.Matsumoto Shiro challenges this classification by interpreting the 64th verse of Śāntarakṣita’s Madhyamakālaṃkāra and its commentary as affirming the existence of external forms (rūpa, ākāra) on a conventional level, thereby criticizing Tsong kha pa’s later interpretation, which emphasizes the absence of external objects even conventionally.This study, therefore, pursues three aims: first, to critically analyze Śāntarakṣita’s theory of appearances; second, to explore Tsong kha pa’s interpretation of this theory within the framework of ākāra-realism; and third, to evaluate Matsumoto’s critique in light of broader contemporary Buddhist scholarship. Through this inquiry, the paper seeks to reconstruct the complex hermeneutical landscape regarding the status of appearances in Madhyamaka philosophy.

115권 호.title_kr: 이제설의 전개 양상과 철학적 의미 탐색 - 초기불교에서 『중론』까지 -
115권 호.title_en: An Inquiry into the Development and Philosophical Meaning of the Two Truths Doctrine - From Early Buddhism to the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā -
115권 호.abstract_kr: This paper examines the historical development of the doctrine of the Two Truths (二諦說) from Early Buddhism to Nāgārjuna’s Mūlamadhyamakakārikā, highlighting its philosophical significance in relation to language, truth, cognition, and liberation. While Early Buddhism does not explicitly distinguish between conventional and ultimate truths, a dual structure implicitly operates through the contrast between nirvāṇa and conditioned phenomena, as well as through the tension between linguistic expression and existential intuition. The Abhidharma schools systematized this structure within a substantialist metaphysics, identifying conventional truth with linguistic constructs and ultimate truth with intrinsic reality. Language was thus regarded as a reliable means of conveying truth, and an epistemology developed that sought ultimate insight through refined conceptual analysis. In contrast, the Prajñāpāramitā scriptures critically dismantle this realist framework, undermining both the notion of intrinsic nature (svabhāva) and the trust in language itself. These texts argue that language cannot convey ultimate truth and propose a reinterpretation of the Two Truths centered on emptiness (śūnyatā) and skillful means (upāya). Building on this critique, Nāgārjuna inherits and systematizes these insights in the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā, articulating the dependent and empty nature of all phenomena and establishing the interdependence of conventional and ultimate truths. While language cannot directly express truth, it can serve a pragmatic, soteriological role within the conditioned world. By interlinking dependent origination, emptiness, nominal designation, and the Middle Way, Nāgārjuna transforms the Two Truths from a doctrinal dichotomy into a dynamic framework for reflecting on language and reality, cognition and practice. This philosophical model laid the foundation for later developments in Madhyamaka thought by Bhāviveka and Candrakīrti, ultimately demonstrating the doctrine’s pivotal role in Buddhism’s linguistic and philosophical turn.

115권 호.title_kr: 불교의 계율에서 본 심신장애의 윤리적 책임성에 대한 고찰 - 한역 율장 및 『범망경』 주석 전통의 시각에서 -
115권 호.title_en: A Study into the Moral Responsibility of Agents with Mental Disabilities in the Buddhist Precepts - From the Perspective of the Chinese Vinaya Translations and the Commentarial Tradition on the Brahmāʼs Net Sūtra(Brahmajāla Sūtra) -
115권 호.abstract_kr: This study scrutinizes the Buddhist Vinaya’s stance on the moral responsibility of agents with mental disabilities through the prism of Article 10 of the Criminal Code, which differentiates among “insanity,” “temporary insanity,” and the doctrine of “actio libera in causa.” The first two legal rubrics correspond to the Vinaya designations chikuang (癡狂, madness) and xinluan (心亂, mental turbulence). Drawing on the Nanti (Nandika; 難提) and Bozhenanti (鉢遮難提) cases preserved in the Mahāsāṃghika Vinaya, the text pronounces non-guilt whenever intention is absent and memory inaccessible owing to such impairment.The Vinayas also canvass scenarios analogous to actio libera in causa, in which an agent deliberately annihilates her own capacity for culpability before the offense. A salient example appears in the Sarvāstivādavinayamātṛkā: an agent, having engineered her slumber, causes her mother’s death; because the homicidal purpose was fully formed during preparation, the act is classified as a Pārājika offense—the gravest transgression. The Dharmaguptaka Vinaya’s doctrine of yifa (倚發) further bifurcates the inception of criminal intent from the act’s consummation.Within the Brahmāʼs Net Sūtra, mens rea likewise constitutes the decisive touchstone for major offenses. Interpretations, however, diverge over the notion of cause (因). Wonhyo (元曉) restricts the “direct cause” to specific criminal intent, foregrounding the agent’s psychological state as the primary yardstick of responsibility. Seungjang (勝莊), by contrast, subsumes under the direct cause both concrete desire (欲樂) and the defilements of greed, hatred, and delusion, yielding a more expansive attribution of blame.Thus the Buddhist precepts adjudicates culpability by calibrating intention against mental condition—a hermeneutic with constructive implications for Buddhist ethics and legal philosophy.

115권 호.title_kr: 한국불교와 범패(梵唄)의 역사 - 신라‧고려 시대 금석문을 중심으로 -
115권 호.title_en: A Study on Bumpae in the History of Korean Buddhism - Focusing on the Inscriptions of Silla and Goryeo -
115권 호.abstract_kr: This study is a review of the Bumpae among intangible cultural properties. In particular, I wanted to examine the a real image of the Bumpae in the history of Korean Buddhism during the Silla and the Goryeo Dynasty.During the Silla period, the introduction and propagation of Dangpung Bumpae are closely associated with Jingam Seonsa(眞鑑禪師). Historical evidence suggests that Dangpung Bumpae was introduced around the reign of King Gyeongdeok, a time marked by increased cultural and religious exchanges with Dang(唐). As the Silla royal court came to emphasize Buddhist ceremonies, the practice of Bumpae flourished accordingly. By the reign of King Gyeongmun and especially toward the end of the Silla dynasty, Bumpae had become a widely practiced and popular ritual element.During the Goryeo Dynasty, Bumpae functioned as a core element of ritual music in state-sponsored Buddhist ceremonies, much like in the Silla Dynasty. Beyond its liturgical function, it also fulfilled significant social roles, such as promoting national security, ensuring political stability, and serving as a means of public consolation. Bumpae was not limited to royal ceremonies; it was also widely practiced in temple ceremonies and Buddihist daliy life. In particular, epigraphic records and biographies of monks often portray Bumpae as a symbolic medium that expressed the spiritual connection between the Sangha and Buddhism.Moreover, Bumpae operated as a practical form of Buddhist expression that the general public could directly experience and participate in. This reveals that in Goryeo society, Bumpae was regarded not only as the sacred sound of Buddhism but also as a popular musical form of religious faith. Consequently, Bumpae played a crucial role in the popularization of Buddhism, eventually securing an important place within the broader landscape of Korean Buddhist culture.
keywords_en: Mihwangsa Sajeokbi(美黃寺 事蹟碑)
Gwangtongboje Seonsa Bi(廣通普濟禪寺碑)

115권 호.title_kr: 간화선에 대한 인지과학적 이해 - 예측처리 이론을 중심으로 -
115권 호.title_en: A Cognitive Science Understanding of Ganhwa Seon - Focusing on Predictive Processing Theory -
115권 호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 현대 인지과학의 주요 패러다임인 예측처리 이론(Predictive Processing)을 통해 한국 선불교 간화선의 화두 수행과 깨달음을 재해석한다. 뇌는 단순히 감각정보를 수동적으로 처리하기보다 미래 상태를 적극적으로 예측하고, 그 예측과 실제 입력 간의 오차를 줄이는 ‘예측 기계’로 작동한다. 간화선 수행자는 역설적 화두를 지속적으로 참구함으로써 극단적 불확실성을 유발하고, 기존 인지모델을 붕괴시켜 급격한 재구성을 통해 깨달음에 이른다. 본 논문은 이러한 과정을 자유에너지 원리 관점에서 해석하며, 깨달음이 곧 뇌의 예측오차 최소화 기제가 극한 상황에서 유도하는 전뇌적 재편임을 제안한다. 아울러 예측처리 이론이 제시하는 신경과학적 근거, 예컨대 명상 시 관찰되는 DMN 억제나 감마파 동기화 등을 연계해 고찰함으로써, 간화선이 단지 신비주의가 아닌 과학적으로 이해 가능한 인지적 전환임을 시사한다. 나아가 불교 전통이 강조해온 공(空)‧무아(無我) 통찰을 현대 과학의 언어로 재설명할 가능성을 모색하며, 명상과 뇌과학 간의 학제적 소통을 활성화하는 출발점을 마련하고자 한다.

115권 호.title_kr: 좌선 자세의 핵심 요소와 효과에 관한 실증적 연구
115권 호.title_en: Study the Effects of Sitting Meditation Posture
115권 호.abstract_kr: This study aims to investigate the effects of the sitting meditation posture. To this end, a survey and interviews were conducted with 117 participants in the ‘Seon Meditation Stay’ program at Goyang Heungguksa Temple, and quantitative and qualitative analyses were performed. The results are as follows: First, an analysis of the effects of the sitting meditation posture revealed that the four core elements (pelvic neutrality, hand, chin, and tongue posture) form the correct posture of the lumbar spine, thoracic spine, cervical spine, and the whole body, and by enabling deep and stable breathing, they contributed to increased feelings of stability, comfort, and concentration. Second, in the analysis of effects according to physical and psychological characteristics, the group with diseases, the group with a very positive attitude towards life, the group with fewer afflictive delusions and the group with a high level of awareness of breathing in daily life showed significantly higher effects in all aspects. Third, the groups that were able to highly aware of their own breathing and significantly notice changes in breathing through posture adjustments showed a strong desire to participate in specialized training programs. Notably, the group with a negative attitude towards life showed higher effects compared to neutral or positive groups and displayed stronger motivation to engage in meditation practice. In conclusion, the sitting meditation posture was found to be an effective meditation tool for modern people by promoting physical and mental relaxation, stability, and increased concentration. In particular, by focusing on enhancing awareness, it was found that individuals could be naturally led to Seon practice. This paper empirically verified the effects of the sitting meditation posture, thereby emphasizing its importance and necessity and suggesting an efficient practice method for practitioners.

115권 호.title_kr: 무종교인을 위한 종교 커뮤니케이션 전략 - 불교 포교의 가능성을 중심으로 -
115권 호.title_en: Religious Communication Strategies for Non-Religious People - Focusing on the Possibilities of Buddhist Missionary Work -
115권 호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 무종교인을 대상으로 종교 메시지의 설득 효과에 영향을 미치는 요인을 실증적으로 분석함으로써, 종교 커뮤니케이션 전략의 학문적 기초를 마련하고자 하였다. 특히 불교적 관점에서 무종교인에 대한 포교 가능성을 탐색하고, 이를 위한 실천적 전략 수립에 이론적 근거를 제공하는 데 목적이 있다.이를 위해 수용자의 성향(포용적/배타적), 메시지 내용의 유형(개인적/사회적), 정보원의 유형(전문가/일반인)이라는 세 가지 독립변인을 설정하고, 2×2 실험 설계를 바탕으로 온라인 설문조사를 실시하였다.연구 결과, 포용적 무종교인은 종교 본질에 대한 태도 변화에서 유의미한 긍정 반응을 보였으며, 특히 개인적 메시지에 노출될 때 설득 효과가 가장 높았다. 반면 배타적 무종교인은 정보원이 전문가일 경우에만 부분적으로 태도 변화가 나타났다.또한 메시지 내용 중 개인적 메시지가 사회적 메시지보다 높은 설득 효과를 유도하였고, 전문가 정보원의 메시지가 일반인보다 더 큰 태도 변화를 초래하였다.이러한 결과는 무종교인의 성향과 수용 맥락에 따른 맞춤형 커뮤니케이션 전략의 필요성을 시사하며, 불교의 자비‧공덕‧해탈이라는 보편 가치를 바탕으로 한 실천적 포교 전략 개발에 중요한 이론적‧실천적 함의를 제공한다.

115권 호.title_kr: 한국불교문화포털 데이터베이스 구조 검토 및 확장 방안 연구
115권 호.title_en: A Study on the Database Structure of the Korean Buddhist Culture Portal and Its Improvement Strategies
115권 호.abstract_kr: This study aims to analyze the current database structure of the Korean Buddhist Culture Portal and propose an improvement plan through the construction of a Relational Database (RDB). At present, the portal primarily delivers information through static, text-oriented content centered on article entries and Buddhist terminology, supplemented by various reference materials. While this structure is effective in conveying the content of individual articles, it lacks the ability to explicitly express relationships among data entities or to enable machine-readable semantic processing. As a solution, this paper suggests a complementary system in which the existing article-based content service and a newly constructed RDB framework operate in an integrated and mutually supportive manner. To achieve this, we define key data types—such as individuals, places, and texts—embedded within articles and propose a method to represent their interrelationships. Based on this structure, a knowledge network can be developed to enhance data connectivity, user navigation, and the overall utility of the portal for digital applications. The study further explores technical methodologies, including ontology- based design and RDF (Resource Description Framework) modeling, and constructs a sample dataset to demonstrate feasibility. Through this integrated approach, the portal can evolve not only as a public platform for disseminating knowledge on Korean Buddhism but also as a foundational resource for future digital Buddhist studies and humanities research.

116권 호.title_en: Jinul’s Theory  of Enlightenment-Driven Practice(先悟後修)  in Beopjipbyeolhaengnok-Jeoryo-Byeongip-Sagi
116권 호.abstract_kr: The Joseon dynasty commentaries on Jinul’s Beopjipbyeolhaengnok- Jeoryo-Byeongip-Sagi greatly enhance our understanding of the text.Among them, Beopjipbyeolhaengnok-Jeoryo-Byeongip-Sagi-Bun’gwa by Sangbong Jeongwon classifies Jinul’s system of practice into three aspects; Perfect Awakening(圓悟), Perfect Cultivation(圓修), and Perfect Realization(圓證). This triadic structure is presented as central to Jinul’s intent and is consistently articulated throughout the text. It reflects Jinul’s in-depth and systematic reinterpretation of Zongmi’s concept of ‘sudden awakening followed by gradual cultivation(頓悟漸修)’, which he further develops into the paradigm of ‘enlightenment-driven practice(先悟後修)’. This paper reexamines Jinul’s theory of enlightenment-driven practice on the basis of Sangbong Jeongwon’s classification of the practice system into Perfect Awakening, Perfect Cultivation, and Perfect Realization.Perfect Awakening refers to realizing that one’s mind, serene and luminously aware(空寂靈知), is originally identical with the Buddha’s mind. However, this initial awakening does not fully eliminate the habitual tendencies of ignorance, necessitating further cultivation.Perfect Cultivation involves relying on awakening to refine one’s mind through two methods: non-conceptual practice(無念修) and task-oriented or situational practice(辦事修). This process emphasizes trusting and observing the mind so as to return to its original nature.Perfect Realization is the state of complete unification with the original mind, achieved through practice grounded in awakening.Jinul reinterprets this as the paradigm of ‘enlightenment-driven practice’. He also introduces an alternative approach via Musim- hapdo(無心合道) of Patriarchal Chan(祖師禪), emphasizing immediate unification with the original mind, thus allowing direct access to Perfect Realization at any moment and in any circumstance.

116권 호.title_kr: 묘음보살의 전법행 연구 - 관세음보살과 비교를 중심으로 -
116권 호.title_en: A Study on the Spreading the Dharma by  Boddhisattva Gadgadasvara - Focusing on Comparison with Avalokitesvara -
116권 호.abstract_kr: Beophwagyeong describes many bodhisattvas. Among them, Bodhisattva Gadgadasvara(妙音菩薩) is very similar to Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva in that he metamorphosis for manifests in various forms and transmits Buddhist teachings to sentient beings, and in many aspects, such as his conduct and appearance, he practices the practice of saving sentient beings. However, he is not well known and is not mentioned as an object of faith.Therefore, the first task is to analyze in detail the merits and deeds of the Bodhisattva Gadgadasvara(妙音菩薩), which is explained by occupying a piece in the Beophwagyeong, and the second goal is to infer the characteristics of Bodhisattva’s conduct by comparing his activities with those of the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and where they are the same and different. I would like to derive a pattern in which Buddhist tactics should be carried out in modern society by examining which part of the Bodhisattva’s activities have brought about such profound differences in their faith and what their actions mean.From the expedient means of transmitting the law, modern Buddhists get a clue about the expedient means of transmitting the right law. The four methods of transmitting the law include the practice of giving and receiving the law (布施攝) and the practice of working together (同事攝).It is not necessary to take the form of an authoritative Dharma master to practice transmitting the law. It can take the form desired by the other person or the form of understanding the other person, sometimes in the form of a merchant in the market, sometimes in the form of a scary form that awakens vigilance or stimulates compassion, or sometimes in the form of a great bodhisattva of the eighth level or higher in the form of a relative or neighbor. If I do not ignore the right words but use them as a way to awaken and develop myself, all beings will become bodhisattvas who guide me, or I will become the mtamorphosis of bodhisattva to those around me, as Bodhisattva Gadgadasvara (妙音菩薩) tells me.

116권 호.title_kr: 문무왕대 의상(義湘, 625-702)의 활동과  부석사 창건의 의미
116권 호.title_en: The Activities of Uisang(625–702) and the  Significance of the Founding of Buseoksa during the  Reign of King Munmu
116권 호.abstract_kr: This study reexamines Uisang’s activities and the founding of Buseoksa during King Munmu’s reign within their political and social contexts. After his teacher Zhiyan’s death in Tang China, Uisang conveyed news of Tang’s planned invasion to the Silla court, also meeting Prince Kim Inmun. Returning home, he sought to establish Naksansa based on Avalokiteśvara devotion but struggled in the capital, where royal-affiliated Buddhist groups held sway. Though granted land in the Taebaek region, Uisang hesitated until Kim Inmun’s temporary investiture by Tang cast suspicion on him. He then accepted King Munmu’s intent and founded Buseoksa in 676. This was not a passive retreat but a strategic decision to secure a base for Hwaeom Buddhism under political constraint. At Buseoksa, Uisang overcame local resistance, drew regional elites into his fold, and spread Hwaeom widely. His authority grew to the extent that he advised on capital construction while remaining at Buseoksa. The case of Buseoksa illustrates how Uisang combined doctrinal skill with practical adaptation, overcoming mistrust to entrench Hwaeom as an institutional force and revealing the close interplay of Buddhism and politics in early Unified Silla.

116권 호.title_kr: 해방 이후 불교교단의 분열과 재편 - 통합종단 출범을 중심으로 -
116권 호.title_en: The Division and Reorganization of the Buddhist  Order in Post-Liberation Korea - With a Focus on the Establishment of the  Unified Order -
116권 호.abstract_kr: This study examines the process of division and reorganization within the Korean Buddhist order after liberation, focusing on the establishment of the Unified Order. It first analyzes how the conflicts between celibate monks and married monks, the disorder in the administrative structure, and differences in ideology and precepts functioned as internal mechanisms of division. In addition to these internal factors, the study also investigates the external mechanism of political intervention by state power in shaping the division and unification of the Buddhist order after liberation. Furthermore, the divisions caused by these mechanisms are explored in the context of the con frontation between the Taego Headquarters of the Chosŏn Buddhist Jogye Order and the Chosŏn Buddhist Orthodoxy Head quarters.The significance of this study lies in its analysis that the Unified Order sought to reorganize the order’s structure through the establishment of a patriarch-centered system, the gradual resolution of the married monks’ issue, the communal manage ment of temple properties, and the institutionalization of mona stic education and ordination practices. Such reorganization carried dual significance: in the contemporary context, it repre sented an effort to overcome the legacies of Japanese coloni alism, while in the present context, it laid the foundation for the organizational framework of the current Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism.For this purpose, the study examined prior research, along with institutional sources such as the Chosŏn Buddhist Constitution and the Buddhist Property Management Act, as well as modern Buddhist historical materials and contemporary press reports, in order to trace the driving forces behind division and unification.This methodology provided the basis for understanding the reorganization of the Buddhist order following the founding of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism.

116권 호.title_kr: 불교적 실천을 통한 섭식장애 관리 - 정신의학·한의학적 관점을 중심 -
116권 호.title_en: Buddhist Practices in Eating Disorder Management - Psychiatric and Oriental Medicine Perspectives -
116권 호.abstract_kr: Eating disorders are not simply a problem of eating habits, but are identified as a complex disorder that deeply affects physical and psychological health and overall social relationships. This study examined the problems of patients with eating disorders from the perspective of Balwoo Gongyang, a Buddhist meal practice, and psychiatric medicine, and reviewed related clinical studies. In addition, from the perspective of oriental medicine, while analyzing organs and emotions, the interactions between physical and psychological symptoms were examined, together with related clinical research results. Through this, the causes and characteristics of eating disorders were understood in a more multidimensional way. Finally, by examining Balwoo Gongyang, which forms the basis of mindful eating, the perspective of viewing food and mind-body was reaffirmed. The possibility of practical methods was examined while contributing to improve ments in self-regulation and psychological stability. As a result, it was confirmed that Buddhist practice can correct distorted per ceptions of food and the body, strengthen self-regulation abilities, and substantially contribute to psychological stability and recovery of physical balance.Moreover, multidisciplinary and integrated research that com bines understanding from psychiatric medicine, oriental medicine, and Buddhist practice provides new academic and practical possibilities for the management and prevention of eating dis orders and the development of long-term treatment strategies.Additionally, this study emphasizes the need for integrated and multidisciplinary research in the fields of Buddhism and medicine, and suggests the possibility of expanding the academic inter section between Buddhism and medicine, as well as the preven tion and long-term management of eating disorders, and sub stantially contributing to the treatment and management of mental and physical health in modern society.

116권 호.title_kr: 마음챙김 명상에서 나타나는 자아의 구축과 해체
116권 호.title_en: Construction and Deconstruction of Self in Mindfulness Meditation
116권 호.abstract_kr: This paper explores the dialectical tension between self- construction and self-dissolution within mindfulness meditation, a practice rooted in Buddhist traditions yet widely adapted into contemporary psychological frameworks. While traditional Buddhism emphasizes insight into non-self (anātman) and the deconstruction of ego-based identification, modern psychology often utilizes mindfulness to build emotional regulation and a coherent sense of self. Rather than treating these approaches as contradictory, I argue that mindfulness operates as a dual mechanism: fostering a functional observer-self while also loosening identification with it.This dual process is examined through key mechanisms such as meta-awareness, perspective-taking, memory reconsolidation, non- attachment, and decentering. These processes allow for both psychological flexibility and ontological transformation.Situating our analysis within the broader context of Buddhist modernism, we examine how mindfulness integrates traditional con templative aims with secular therapeutic applications. By high lighting the interplay of opposing tendencies—stabilizing and dissolving the self—we present mindfulness not as a linear path but as a dynamic space where transformation arises from em bracing internal tension. This integrated framework offers new insight into how mindfulness facilitates both healing and wisdom, bridging cognitive-emotional regulation with deeper existential awareness.

116권 호.title_kr: 토픽 모델링을 활용한 염불 분야 학술 담론 분석
116권 호.title_en: Analyzing Academic Discourse in the Field of Buddhism using Topic Modeling
116권 호.abstract_kr: This study employed topic modelling, a text mining technique within digital humanities, to conduct an in-depth analysis of the structure and evolving patterns within the academic discourse on Buddhist chanting in Korea.The research subjects comprised 229 academic papers on chan ting published in KCI-listed and candidate journals from 2005 to April 2025. TF-IDF-based preprocessing and the LDA algorithm were applied to the collected data, yielding eight major topics.These topics encompassed the process and methodology of chan ting practice, the musical structure and rhythmic characteristics of chanting, the doctrinal development of Pure Land thought and chanting, the narrative structure and linguistic features of chanting literature, the ritual practices of rebirth aspirations and Amitābha Buddha devotion, the historical evolution and regional particularities of chanting practice, the position of chanting as a Buddhist ritual and its musical characteristics, and chanting practice and the concept of “chanting meditation” within the Zen tradition.This study sought to address the methodological limitations of previous research, which relied heavily on literature reviews, prior knowledge, and subjective interpretations. To this end, a novel analytical approach was introduced to overcome the objectivity and generalisability constraints inherent in qualitative methodolo gies. Through data-based quantitative analysis, the objective structure and temporal developmental patterns of chanting discourse were empirically elucidated. These findings will serve as crucial foundational material, pointing the way towards the digitisation of chanting research, data-based convergent analysis, and interdisciplinary collaborative studies in the future.

116권 호.title_kr: 의상대사 법성게와 한‧일 불교음악 - 일본 가나자와(金澤)문고 쇼묘하카세(聲明博士)를 통하여 -
116권 호.title_en: The Dharma Nature Gatha by Venerable Uisang and  The Korean-Japanese Buddhist Music - A Study through Shomyo notation Preserved at  Shomyo-ji in Japan -
116권 호.abstract_kr: Ennin, who established Japanese Shomyō repeatedly mentioned that the Shilla-style rituals and Buddhist chants he saw at Silla’s Temple, Sandong-jeoksan Beopwhoawon (山東赤山法華院) were the same as those in Japan. This indicates that the Buddhist chants of Silla were transmitted to Japan and were recited during ceremonies before Ennin went to study in Tang China. The oldest existing shomyo Neuma score ‘Shotenhakase (声点博士)’ is identical to the four tones in “『Jakbeopguigam作法龜鑑』” written by Korean Monk Baekpa (白坡) during the Joseon Dynasty, and also identical to the four tones described by Chinese Monk Tsuzong (處忠) of Tang dynasty in “『yuánhéyùnpǔ元和韻譜』”.Korea, under the policy of suppressing Buddhism and promo ting Confucianism, only transcribed Confucian music into nota tion, while Buddhist music was not notated. In contrast, in Japan, Buddhist music was performed as court and temple gagaku, and the theory and notation system of Shōmyō developed, leading to the transmission of many Shōmyō scores. Among them, some scores of Hwaeom-wonryoungchan are preserved in the Kanazawa Library of Shōmyo-ji. An analysis of the Hwaeom-wonryoungchan and Kangen Bairo (管絃 倍爐) musical scores in the Kanazawa Library of Shomyōji revealed that, although there were changes in the minor details over time, the initial notes, main structural notes, and final notes remained unchanged. Given Japan’s conservative approach to preserving the original form, this suggests that the structural framework of the rhythm pattern, which originated with the Dharma Name Verse of the Silla monk Uisang and was transmitted to Goryeo before reaching Japan, may have been preserved.The Shōmyōji Hwaeum-wonryoungchan includes not only vocal scores but also Bairo singing with instrumental accompaniment scores for the Bairo, and it is expected to serve as an important foundation for the study of Korean and Japanese Buddhist history, as well as for the revival of lost Korean Hwaeum practice and Buddhist music.

117권 호.title_kr: 조선불교조계종 초대 종정으로서 한암 중원의 종단 운영관 - 종정 재임 기간(1941-1945) 발표된 법어를 중심으로 -
117권 호.title_en: Hanam Jung-won’s View of Administration for the Jogye Order of Joseon Buddhism as Its First Supreme Patriarch - Focusing on the Discourses Delivered during  His Tenure (1941-1945) -
117권 호.abstract_kr: 본 연구의 목적은 한암 중원이 조선불교조계종 초대 종정 재임기(1941-1945) 동안 설했던 법어들을 분석하여, 종단 운영에 관한 그의 생각을 알아보는 데 있다. 한암은 조선불교조계종 창종 과정에서 종명 선정과 재단 설립 등에 기여했으며, 종단 출범 직후 압도적인 지지를 받아 초대 종정으로 선출되었다. 임기 중에는 불교 잡지에 발표된 종정 명의의 법어를 통해 자신의 견해를 종단 구성원들에게 전달하였다.한암의 종단 운영관은 출가자의 본분과 계율 중시, 선 중심의 통합적 수행가풍, 소임과 사무를 통한 정진이라는 세 가지 특징을 갖는다. 그는 지계‧수행‧화합을 실현하여 스스로 깨닫고 중생을 제도하는 것을 출가자의 역할로 제시하면서, 이를 위한 요건으로 계율의 중요성을 강조하였다. 수행 면에서는 간화선의 화두 참구를 중추로 삼되 간경‧염불‧주력 등 선 수행 이외의 방편도 폭넓게 인정했는데, 이는 청허 휴정 이후의 조선 중‧후기 전통과 맞닿아 있다. 또 각자 맡은 일에 최선을 다하는 것이 정진임을 역설하며 종단의 소임 및 사무에도 수행의 의미를 부여하였다.현대 한국불교의 종단 운영에 있어서도 한암이 가르친 내용들은 여전히 유효하다. 선을 중심으로 여타 방편들을 수용하는 수행가풍은 조선불교조계종의 후신인 조선불교와 대한불교조계종의 교헌 및 종헌에 반영되어 해방 이후 한국불교의 종풍 확립에 영향을 주었다. 종무를 수행으로 받아들이는 태도는 수행 분위기 조성 및 종단 구성원에 대한 포용과 존중의 측면에서 시사점을 갖는다.
117권 호.abstract_en: This study examines Hanam Jung-won (漢巖重遠, 1876–1951)’s views on the administration of the Buddhist order through an analysis of the discourses he delivered during his tenure as the first Supreme Patriarch (宗正, Jongjeong) of the Jogye Order of Joseon Buddhism (hereafter JOJB). Hanam helped found JOJB by selecting its name and establishing its institutional foundation. Shortly after the order’s inauguration, he was elected its first Supreme Patriarch with broad support. During his term, he articulated his vision for the order through discourses published under his name in Buddhist journals.Hanam’s conception of order administration is characterized by three key features: an emphasis on the fundamental responsibilities and disciplinary precepts of monastics, an integrative Seon- centered approach to practice, and an understanding of diligent engagement in assigned duties and administrative work as spiritual practice. He defined the role of monastics as awakening themselves and guiding sentient beings through moral discipline, practice, and communal harmony, stressing the observance of precepts as a prerequisite. In terms of practice, he placed Ganhwaseon at the core while also acknowledging other methods, such as scriptural study, chanting, and mantra recitation. This style reflects the Buddhist traditions of the middle and late Joseon periods following Cheongheo Hyujeong (淸虛休靜, 1520–1604). Furthermore, he emphasized that fulfilling one’s assigned roles with sincerity constitutes diligent effort, thereby attributing religious significance to works within the order.Hanam’s teachings remain relevant to the contemporary Korean Buddhist administration. A Seon-centered yet inclusive approach informed the constitutions of the successors of JOJB—Joseon Buddhism and the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism—and shaped the practicing styles of Korean Buddhist orders after liberation. The notion of administration as religious practice offers guidance for cultivating a practicing atmosphere, inclusivity, and mutual respect within today’s Buddhist order.

117권 호.title_kr: 『대승기신론』(大乘起信論) 최초기 주석서의 심(心)‧의(意)‧의식(意識) 해석 고찰 - 『행우서옥본』(杏雨書屋本)과 담연(曇延)의 『기신론의소』(起信論義疏) 검토 -
117권 호.title_en: An Examination of the Interpretations of Mind(心), Intention(意) and Consciousness(意識) in the Earliest Commentaries on the Awakening of Faith in the Mahāyāna - With a Focus on the kyōu Library’s manuscript(杏雨書屋本) and the Qixinlun Uishu(起信論義
117권 호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 『기신론』의 현존하는 최초기 주석서인 『행우서옥본』과 『담연소』의 검토를 통해 심‧의‧의식에 대한 해석을 고찰하고, 그 의미를 분석함으로써 연구의 이해 기반을 마련하고자 한다.『기신론』은 6세기 진제의 역서로 중국에 등장한 후, 원효와 법장의 주석서가 저술되면서 영향력이 크게 발휘된다. 하지만 이러한 위상에도 불구하고 성립 및 저술 시기, 전승 등의 세부 사항이 명확하지 않아 『기신론』을 해석하는 교리적 요소 역시 다양하게 나타난다. 그중에서도 심‧의‧의식의 해석은 사상가에 따라 분명한 차이를 보이며 『행우서옥본』과 『담연소』에서도 이러한 차이가 확인된다. 따라서 본 연구는 이들의 검토를 통해 심‧의‧의식이 어떠한 개념적 체계 속에서 이해되는지를 분석하였다. 그 결과 『행우서옥본』은 심을 전변의 대상으로 설정하고, 심‧의‧의식을 본식을 중심으로 하여 기능적으로 구분되는 개념으로 파악한다. 또한 『섭대승론석』이 알라야식을 일체법의 의지처이자 종자식으로 해석한 관점을 『기신론』에 그대로 적용하여 『기신론』의 알라야식에 불생불멸의 성격이 내재된 점은 고려하지 못한다.반면 『담연소』는 심을 의와 의식이 전개되는 근본 토대로 설정하고 본식이자 알라야식으로 규정한다. 또한 『불성론』에 근거하여 심은 여래장의 자성을 체로 하고 종자의 작용을 용으로 하는 알라야식으로, 의와 의식은 이 식이 무명을 연으로 하여 전개되는 생멸심의 작용으로 이해한다. 이는 심을 여래장의 체성을 내재한 알라야식으로 이해하는 해석 틀을 제시함으로써, 이후 『기신론』 주석서에서 알라야식을 해석하는 근간을 마련한 것이라 할 수 있다.
117권 호.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine interpretations of mind, intention, and consciousness through an analysis of the Kyōu Library’s manuscript(杏雨書屋本) and the Qixinlun Uishu(起信論義疏) by Tan-yan(曇延), which constitute the earliest extant commentaries on the Awakening of Faith in the Mahāyāna, and thereby to establish a foundation for understanding their doctrinal significance.Interpretations of mind, intention and consciousness in the Awakening of Faith in the Mahāyāna vary significantly among thinkers, and such differences are also evident in the Kyōu Library’s manuscript and the Qixinlun Uishu.The Kyōu Library’s manuscript treats mind as the object of transformation and distinguishes mind, intention and consciousness as functional concepts centered on the fundamental consciousness. By directly adopting the Mahāyānasaṃgraha-bhāṣya(攝大乘論釋)’s view of ālayavijñāna as the support of all dharmas and a repository of seeds to the Awakening of Faith in the Mahāyāna it overlooks the non-arising and non-ceasing character intrinsic to the text’s account of ālayavijñāna.In contrast, the Qixinlun Uishu identifies mind as the fundamental consciousness—ālayavijñāna—from which intention and consciousness arise. On the basis of the Fo xing lun(佛性論), it interprets mind as ālayavijñāna whose essence is the tathāgatagarbha and whose function lies in the operation of seeds, while intention and consciousness are understood as functions of the arising-and-ceasing mind conditioned by ignorance. This interpretive framework subsequently shaped later commentarial understandings of ālayavijñāna in the Awakening of Faith in the Mahāyāna.

117권 호.title_kr: 전도에 대한 월칭의 관점 고찰 - 『사백론주』(Catuḥśatakaṭīkā)를 중심으로 -
117권 호.title_en: The Candrakīrti’s View of viparyāsa – A Study of the Catuḥśatakaṭīkā (CŚṬ) –
117권 호.abstract_kr: 본고는 월칭이 『프라산나파다』(PSP)에서 전도와 비전도 모두를 자성 없는 것으로 해체하면서도, 『사백론주』(CŚṬ)에서는 무상‧고‧무아‧부정을 네 가지 전도(상‧락‧아‧정)의 대치법으로 인정하는 이유를 규명한다. 이를 위해, 『근본중론송』(MMK) 제23장 13–14, 20–21, 22송과 PSP를 중심으로 ‘전도와 비전도의 동시 해체’가 성립하는 논증 구조를 분석한다. 특히, 제22송의 ‘전도 소멸’을 대상의 물리적 소멸이 아니라 실체화된 포착이 더 이상 유지되지 않는 인지적 전환으로 재해석한다. 또한 이 전환을 월칭의 교설 전략 속에 위치시키기 위해 『공칠십론주』와 『육십송여리론주』, 『입중론』(및 주석)의 관련 논의를 교차 검토하여, 공성의 즉각적 설법이 낳을 수 있는 악취공의 위험과 근기 고려라는 조건 아래에서 세속제의 교설이 방편으로 요청됨을 밝힌다. 마지막으로 『사백론』(CŚ) 제1–4장과 CŚṬ를 통해 무상 등이 전도된 집착을 교정하는 치료적 진리로 작동함을 논증하고, PSP의 승의적 해체와 CŚṬ의 세속적 처방이 ‘해체(승의)–처방(세속)’이라는 기능 분화 속에서 하나의 구원론적 전략으로 통합됨을 제시한다.
117권 호.abstract_en: This article examines why Candrakīrti deconstructs both viparyāsa and its corrective counterpart, aviparyāsas as lacking svabhāva in the Prasannapadā (PSP), while endorsing impermanence, suffering, non–self, and impurity as pratipakṣa (antidontes) to the four distortions in the Catuḥśatakaṭīkā (CŚṬ). Focusing on Mūlamadhyamakakārikā (MMK) Chapter 23 (vv. 23.13–14, 20–21, 22) and the PSP, it clarifies the logic by which even “correct” cognitions become problematic when reified, and it reinterprets the “cessation of viparyāsa” in MMK 23.22 not as the disappearance of an object but as a cognitive shift–namely, the cessation of reifying apprehensioin. It then situates this shift within Candrakīrti’s pedagogical strategy by reading relevant discussions in the Yuktiṣaṣṭikāvṛtti (YṢV), the Śūnyatāsaptativṛtti (ŚSV), and the Madhyamakāvatārabhāṣya (MABh), showing that an immediate exposition of emptiness risks being misconstrued as nihilism and therefore necessitates a prior, conventional stage of instruction. Finally, through an analysis of Catuḥśataka (CŚ) Chapter 1–4 and the CŚṬ, the paper argues that thess “antidotes” function as therapeutic truths at the saṃvṛti level, correcting attachments to permanence, pleasure, self, and purity. The apparent tension between the PSP’s ultimate–level deconstruction and the CŚṬ’s conventiona–level prescriptions is thus resolved as a single soteriological starategy: a functional differentiation between ultimate truth and conventional truth governed by upāya.

117권 호.title_kr: 불교영화 <마음의 고향>(1949)의 유년 주체와 인식의 드라마
117권 호.title_en: The Child Subject and the Drama of Cognition in the Buddhist Film Maeumui Gohyang (A Hometown in Heart, 1949)
117권 호.abstract_kr: 본고는 윤용규 감독의 불교영화 <마음의 고향>(1949)을 대상으로, 작품이 ‘어머니 찾기’ 서사를 수행과 인식의 문제로 재구성하는 양상을 살핀다. 먼저 열두 살 동자승 도성이 사찰 규율을 학습하는 국면에 놓여 있음을 전제로, 사찰 노동과 예불 준비의 반복, 산문(山門) 안/밖의 공간 대비, ‘키재기’ 표식, ‘새 잡기’ 사건 등을 통해 유년 정동이 규율 속에서 억압되면서도 부분적으로 표면화되는 지점을 검토하였다. 다음으로 염주알 속 연꽃을 인식의 표지로 보고, 도성이 표지에 의존한 채 ‘대면불식(對面不識)’에 이르는 무명(無明)의 구조를 분석하였다. 아울러 통곡 장면의 지속 쇼트와 긴 호흡을 형식적 특징으로 제시하고, 이러한 형식이 관객의 정동 경험을 지연시키는 방식을 확인하였다. 끝으로 도성의 떠남을 어머니를 향한 이동으로만 환원하지 않고, 제도적 수행에서 실존적 수행으로 ‘출가’의 의미가 이동하는 결말로 해석하였다. 이를 통해 <마음의 고향>이 유년 정동과 불교 인식론을 결합하여 불교영화의 미학적 가능성을 보여준다는 점을 제시한다.
117권 호.abstract_en: This article rereads Yun Yong-gyu’s A Hometown in Heart (1949) as a Buddhist film and examines how it transforms an “in search of the mother” plot into a drama of practice and cognition. Focusing on the twelve-year-old novice monk Doseong, the study first argues that the film foregrounds not spiritual attainment but a pedagogical phase in which monastic discipline is learned and rehearsed. Through the repeated cycles of temple labor and ritual preparation, the sustained spatial contrast between inside and outside the temple gate, the bodily mark of “measuring height,” and the episode of “catching a bird,” the film reveals how childhood affect—longing, anxiety, and lack—is repressed within disciplinary rhythms yet persistently leaks out through gesture, gaze, and movement.The article then interprets the film’s central symbol—the lotus sealed inside a rosary bead—not as a mere prop but as an epistemic device that organizes recognition and misrecognition. It shows how Doseong’s reliance on a sign prevents him from recognizing the truth before his eyes, leading to daemyeon bulsik (face- to-face nonrecognition) and exposing a structure of ignorance (avidyā). The climactic wail is presented not through psychological explanation but through long duration and sustained takes, compelling viewers to endure the weight and time of grief rather than consume it as an immediately legible meaning. In conclusion, the film’s ending is read not simply as a departure toward the mother but as a reconfiguration of chulga—from institutional practice (monastic rules) to existential practice (a decision enacted on the road)—thereby articulating a distinctive Buddhist-film aesthetics that fuses childhood affect with Buddhist epistemology.

117권 호.title_kr: 불교를 바라보는 인공지능의 시선 - 거대언어모델(LLM)의 불교 지식 비교 분석 -
117권 호.title_en: The AI Perspective on Buddhism - A Comparative Analysis of Buddhist Knowledge in Large Language Model -
117권 호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 거대언어모델(LLM)이 불교라는 전문적‧문화적 지식 체계를 얼마나 정확하고 신뢰성 있게 이해하고 재현할 수 있는지를 실증적으로 분석하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 대한불교조계종 포교원이 발행한 『포교사 고시 예상문제집』을 기반으로 총 90문항의 평가 데이터셋을 구축하고, 실제 포교사 시험 형식을 반영하여 1‧2세션(각 45문항, 객관식 40‧주관식 5)으로 구성하였다. 실험 대상은 OpenAI GPT-5.2, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek Chat이며, 모든 실험은 API 기반으로 수행하고 온도 값을 0으로 고정하였다. 또한 정답, 추론 근거, 확신도를 포함한 구조화된 JSON 응답을 강제하였다.분석 결과, Gemini와 Claude 모델은 높은 정답률을 보였으나 확신도 보정의 한계가 확인되었고, OpenAI 모델은 비교적 안정적인 확신도 분포를 보였다. 반면 DeepSeek 모델은 높은 확신도에도 불구하고 정답률이 낮아 고확신 오답의 위험성이 두드러졌다. 이러한 결과는 LLM이 불교 교리를 개념적으로 설명하는 ‘지(知)’의 차원에서는 높은 수행력을 보이지만, 의례‧전승‧체험의 맥락에서 형성되는 ‘혜(慧)’의 차원에는 구조적 한계를 지님을 보여준다. 본 연구는 이를 통해 불교 인식론의 지‧혜 구분을 현대 AI 환경에서 실증적으로 재확인하며, 인공지혜를 AI 자체의 지혜가 아닌 인간의 수행과 성찰을 보조하는 방편적 인프라로 재정의할 필요성을 제기한다.
117권 호.abstract_en: This study aims to empirically examine how accurately and reliably large language models (LLMs) can understand and reproduce Buddhism as a specialized and culturally embedded system of knowledge.To this end, a dataset of 90 evaluation items was constructed based on The Predicted Question Book for the Buddhist Missionary Examination published by the Buddhist Promotion Bureau of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism.Reflecting the actual structure of the missionary examination, the dataset was organized into two sessions, each consisting of 45 questions (40 multiple-choice items and 5 open-ended questions).The models evaluated in this study include OpenAI GPT-5.2, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5, and DeepSeek Chat.All experiments were conducted via APIs with the temperature parameter fixed at 0, and each model was required to produce structured JSON outputs containing the selected answer, the reasoning process, and a self-reported confidence score.The results show that the Gemini and Claude models achieved high accuracy rates, but exhibited limitations in confidence calibration.The OpenAI model demonstrated a relatively stable distribution of confidence levels, whereas the DeepSeek model displayed a pronounced risk of high-confidence errors, showing low accuracy despite consistently high confidence scores.These findings indicate that while LLMs perform strongly at the level of knowledge (知, ji)—that is, the conceptual explanation of Buddhist doctrines—they exhibit structural limitations at the level of wisdom (慧, hye), which is shaped through ritual practice, transmission, and embodied experience.This study thus empirically reaffirms the classical Buddhist epistemological distinction between knowledge and wisdom in the context of contemporary AI systems, and argues for a reconceptualization of artificial wisdom not as wisdom inherent to AI itself, but as an instrumental infrastructure that supports human practice and reflective cultivation.

117권 호.title_kr: 템플스테이 웰니스 구성 요소의 탐색 - 제주 관음사 사례 연구 -
117권 호.title_en: Exploring the Wellness Dimensions of Templestay - A Case Study of Gwaneumsa Temple in Jeju Island -
117권 호.abstract_kr: 전 세계 웰니스 시장의 성장과 함께 웰니스 관광이 새로운 관광 트렌드로 부상하고 있으며, 템플스테이는 한국의 대표적인 웰니스 관광 상품으로 자리매김하고 있다. 본 연구의 목적은 한국 불교 조계종 제23교구 본사인 제주 관음사 템플스테이 참가자들이 인식하는 웰니스 구성 요소의 중요도와 만족도를 체계적으로 분석하는 데 있다. 기존 템플스테이 연구들은 체험 만족도 중심으로 이루어졌던 한계를 보완하여, 웰니스 구성 요소 간의 상대적 중요도와 불교 문화 프로그램 경험의 구조를 실증적으로 검토하고자 하였다.이를 위해 템플스테이 참가자를 대상으로 6가지 웰니스 구성 요소(신체적‧감성적‧지적‧정신적‧사회적‧영적)에 대한 중요도–만족도 분석(Importance–Performance Analysis, IPA)을 실시하고, 심층 면담을 병행하였다. 분석 결과, 명상과 자기성찰 등 정신적‧감성적 구성 요소는 높은 중요도와 만족도를 보였지만 영적‧신체적 구성 요소는 중요도에 비해 만족도가 낮아 개선이 필요한 영역으로 나타났다. 이는 불교 수행 프로그램에서 수행의 의미와 목적에 대한 해설과 성찰 과정이 웰니스 성과에 중요한 역할을 함을 시사한다. 본 연구는 불교 기반 웰니스 프로그램의 해석과 운영에 대한 학문적‧실천적 시사점을 제시한다.
117권 호.abstract_en: Global interest in the wellness market has increased in recent years, and wellness tourism has emerged as a prominent tourism trend. In this context, Templestay in South Korea has developed into a representative form of wellness tourism. The purpose of this study is to systematically analyze the importance and satisfaction of wellness components perceived by participants in the Gwaneumsa Templestay, conducted at Gwaneumsa Temple, the head temple of the 23rd district of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism. This study addresses the limitations of previous Templestay research, which has primarily focused on experiential satisfaction, by empirically examining the relative importance of wellness components and the structural characteristics of practice- based experiences.This study applies Importance Performance Analysis (IPA) to six wellness components including physical, emotional, intellectual, mental, social, and spiritual dimensions, based on survey data collected from Templestay participants, and complements the analysis with in depth interviews. The results indicate that mental and emotional components, such as meditation and self-reflection, play an important role in stress reduction and emotional stability, whereas spiritual and physical components show relatively low satisfaction despite their perceived importance. These findings highlight the need to further consider how Buddhist practice based programs are interpreted and structured in relation to participants’ wellness experiences. This study provides academic and practical implications for the interpretation and operation of Buddhist based wellness programs.
